title: Head of Americas, Product
descriptionHtml:
Head of Product, Americas – New York City, NY

PineBridge Investments, A MetLife Investment Management Company.

MetLife Investment Management (MIM) has successfully acquired PineBridge as of December 30, 2025. MetLife Investment Management and PineBridge Investments now have more to offer; broader reach, deeper insights and specialized capabilities – forming a top-tier global investment platform.

Together, we have more than $700 billion in assets under management as of September 30, 2025 and aim to deliver consistent risk-adjusted returns. From multi-asset, equities, and fixed income to private credit and real estate, we offer specialized capabilities backed by a broader global reach and regionally grounded insights tailored to investor needs.

What sets us apart isn’t just the breadth of our platform and capabilities — it’s how we partner. Across both firms, we share a strong investment culture that prioritizes partnership, transparency and accountability. We believe that our clients benefit from direct access to decision-makers and reinforced by a culture that views decisions through the client’s perspective. Join us and experience the excitement of working with the brightest minds in the industry, shaping the future of asset management.

The role will be based in New York City with the expectation of a hybrid work model.

The Americas Head of Product will own and drive MIM’s product strategy, development and management efforts in the region. The role requires a deep understanding of public and private markets and how to enable access to these capabilities across investor channels. The successful candidate will play a critical role in assessing, prioritizing and delivering a pipeline of products in line with MIM’s strategic ambitions, and will be responsible for the Americas product suite throughout the product lifecycle. It is necessary to have the gravitas and confidence to operate at all levels of the organization, including senior leadership, and the judgement to provide constructive challenge and help shape effective decision making.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Product function in the Americas across product strategy, development, and management for public and private markets. You will be the go-to person for all product-related matters in the region
  • Stay on top of trends and opportunities with support from the Product Intelligence team; deliver proactive insights to inform decision making on the go-forward Product strategy
  • In partnership with the Global Head of Product and broader team, develop a focused product pipeline for the region that prioritizes client needs, aligns with MIM’s broader strategy, and facilitates efficient scale and profitability
  • Lead the end-to-end process of product design, launch, enhancements and closures in the Americas
  • Oversight of the Americas Product line up to support the delivery of strategic objectives and financial targets
  • Present information and recommendations to a variety of internal and external stakeholders in a clear, confident manner, including Board and Committee Members and Senior Leadership
  • Build strong and robust relationships with colleagues across functions to ensure effective product delivery including Client Group, Investments, Legal, Operations, and Senior Management
  • Act as a trusted advisor to colleagues; instill confidence in your ability and constructively challenge thinking where needed
  • Uphold a strong risk management and compliance culture within the Product function, operating within regulatory and statutory requirements and ensure that MIM meets its fiduciary responsibilities

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience (10+ years) across product strategy, development and management (full product lifecycle)
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent from an accredited college or university
  • Track record of successful strategic planning, direction, and execution on high-priority matters
  • Strong investment knowledge across public and private markets strategies
  • Experience in establishing and maintaining comingled funds, funds of one, and SMAs for the Americas across investor channels
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and nurture strategic relationships with team members across functions and levels of seniority to lead and influence the determination and execution of initiatives
  • Familiarity with harnessing data from key databases to help inform decision making and prioritization, such as eVestment, Preqin, Broadridge, etc.
  • Ability to understand complex product and structuring issues to ensure proper direction and efficient resolution
  • Decisive and able to work independently to drive initiatives forward
  • Ability to multi-task and manage conflicting priorities while staying organized to achieve success for the firm

About PineBridge

PineBridge is proud of our award-winning culture, which reflects our commitment to empowering employees and fostering a collaborative work environment. For six consecutive years (2020-2025), PineBridge has been named a ‘Best Place to Work in Money Management’ by Pensions & Investments, a leading industry designation which recognizes the best employers in the asset management industry by evaluating employer benefits, policies, and responses to an employee survey. In 2023, PineBridge received Hong Kong Institute for HR Management Elite awards for ‘Best Workplace’ and ‘Learning & Development’ and in 2024 we received Merit awards for ‘Talent Acquisition’ and ‘Employee Benefits.’ Alongside this, in 2023 and 2024 PineBridge was recognized as a finalist at the 100 Women in Finance’s APAC Industry Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Award.

Our benefits: We offer a wide range of family friendly benefits including comprehensive healthcare, back-up childcare program to support working parents and flexible work arrangements so you can be there for the people you care about. We also provide a competitive retirement plan and tuition reimbursement. Furthermore, we have a robust list of professional development opportunities with the goal of engaging, retaining, and developing our talent.

Our values: We value our clients, investment excellence, collaboration with our distributed team members, empowerment, and independence as we honor our heritage and our roots.

  • Salary Range: $250,000-280,000 annually + bonus + benefits
  • The above represents the expected salary range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we’ll consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.

PineBridge is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace, providing opportunities for all qualified persons and maintaining an environment free from all forms of harassment and discrimination for its employees. PineBridge is dedicated to recruiting, hiring, training and promoting into all job levels the most qualified applicants without regard to actual or perceived age, race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, height, weight, sex, gender (including gender identity), disability, pregnancy, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, AIDS/HIV status, military status, alienage or citizenship status, genetic information, domestic violence victim status or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. At PineBridge, we strive to create an inclusive environment that attracts, retains, and develops the best global talent, leveraging the unique backgrounds, skills, and perspectives that all our people bring to work.

descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Director of Product based in France.

This role is a senior product leadership position responsible for defining and driving the vision, strategy, and execution of a global Employer of Record platform. You will own the end-to-end product experience across the entire employment lifecycle, ensuring seamless workflows that enable companies to hire, onboard, manage, and pay international talent at scale. The role sits at the intersection of product strategy, regulatory complexity, and operational execution, requiring a strong systems-thinking mindset. You will lead multiple Product Managers and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Go-To-Market teams. The environment is highly cross-functional, fast-evolving, and deeply mission-driven, with a strong emphasis on clarity, scalability, and measurable outcomes. This is a high-impact leadership role shaping both product direction and organizational execution standards across a global platform.

Accountabilities

title: Head Of Product (Ai-First)
descriptionHtml:
Sobre Mapit

En Mapit diseñamos tecnología —hardware y software— para la movilidad conectada.

Mediante un ecosistema integrado, potenciamos el vínculo entre marcas como Honda y sus clientes, a través de soluciones que combinan IoT, firmware, analítica avanzada, inteligencia artificial y experiencias digitales.

Ubicación

Barcelona

Modelo híbrido: 3 días en oficina en Barcelona, 2 días en remoto

Full-time

Nuestro reto

Nuestro reto no es solo técnico: es crear un ecosistema digital de servicios que mejore radicalmente la experiencia del usuario final.

Y para eso, buscamos personas senior que quieran tener impacto real en producto y en el equipo que lo crea.

El rol

Mapit está en un momento de crecimiento donde el producto necesita un liderazgo dedicado.

Hoy, muchas decisiones de producto pasan por el CEO — y eso no escala.

Buscamos a alguien que asuma el ownership del producto digital: que defina hacia dónde va, que decida qué se construye y en qué orden, y que lidere al equipo que lo hace realidad.

Liderarás todo el producto digital de Mapit y al equipo de producto/tecnología (8 personas entre devs, producto y data).

Estructurarás el proceso de ideación y validación: asegurar que cada iniciativa llega con evidencia clara, su estimación de coste e impacto, y un estado visible del pipeline de decisiones.

Reportarás directamente al CEO, con autonomía sobre producto.

Tu Responsabilidad Se Reparte En Tres Ejes

Producto

Definir y ejecutar el roadmap, priorizando por impacto real en negocio y usuario.

Ser el punto de referencia para decisiones de producto: qué se construye, qué no, y por qué.

Coordinar producto, negocio y tecnología para que las prioridades estén alineadas y las entregas sean predecibles.

Tecnología y equipo

Liderar al equipo técnico: dar dirección, eliminar bloqueos, asegurar calidad y ritmo de entrega.

Impulsar decisiones basadas en datos y acompañar al CTO en las decisiones de infraestructuras para que soporten el crecimiento.

IA

Implementar y supervisar soluciones de IA aplicadas al producto (trabajando con herramientas como Claude, APIs de modelos, pipelines de datos).

Mejorar el proceso de creación de producto donde la IA suponga una mejora tangible.

Experiencia real trabajando con IA en el día a día y entender cómo cambia los flujos de producción: ciclos más cortos, nuevas formas de iterar, y cómo integrar esto en la forma de trabajar del equipo.

Ser la referencia del equipo en adopción de IA: desde herramientas de desarrollo (Claude Code) hasta casos de uso en el producto.

El perfil que buscamos

+8 años de experiencia liderando producto digital end-to-end (apps, SaaS, plataformas) con equipos a tu cargo.

Capacidad real de combinar visión de producto con profundidad técnica — el CTO lidera las decisiones de arquitectura, pero tú entiendes el contexto, hablas con devs en su idioma y participas con criterio.

Experiencia implementando o supervisando IA aplicada a producto — no teórica, sino práctica: has trabajado con APIs de modelos, has integrado IA en flujos reales, sabes distinguir lo que aporta valor de lo que es hype.

Fuerte criterio de priorización: sabes decir "no" y defender por qué.

Capacidad para trabajar con un CEO involucrado en la experiencia de producto, construyendo una relación de confianza donde ganes autonomía progresivamente con resultados.

Español e inglés avanzado (C1).

Muy valorable

Experiencia en IoT, plataformas conectadas o entornos donde convienen hardware y software.

Experiencia en modelos B2B2C (marcas + usuarios finales).

Haber trabajado en empresas en fase de crecimiento o scale-up, donde la estructura se construye mientras se ejecuta.

Este rol es para ti si...

Te motiva construir, no solo planificar — prefieres un entorno donde tu trabajo tiene impacto directo cada semana.

Te gusta liderar desde la trinchera: estás igual de cómodo/a en una sesión de roadmap que resolviendo un bloqueo técnico con el equipo.

Necesitas poca estructura para avanzar — te organizas bien en entornos con ambigüedad y sabes crear orden donde no lo hay.

La IA no es un tema de conversación para ti, es una herramienta que ya usas a diario para trabajar mejor.

Lo que ofrecemos

Producto propio con impacto real, en un equipo que trabaja en la frontera de IoT e inteligencia artificial.

Contrato indefinido y salario competitivo, acorde a tu experiencia y responsabilidad.

Modelo híbrido: 3 días en oficina en Barcelona, 2 días en remoto.

Horario flexible con viernes tarde libre.

Seguro médico Adeslas gratuito.

23 días de vacaciones + 10 días adicionales de teletrabajo al año.

Dispositivos y Suscripciones Mapit gratuitos.

Sabemos que nadie encaja al 100 % en una descripción.

Si tienes experiencia liderando producto y tecnología, criterio técnico y ganas de construir algo con impacto, aplica, aunque no marques todas las casillas.

title: Head of Physical Products & IoT
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

As Head of Physical Products & IoT you'll lead our entire physical product stack: towers, turnstiles, mobile nodes, fleet management systems, and back-end support applications. This means P&L ownership, building product life cycle processes from scratch, and coaching a team of 7+ Product Owners and Product Specialists to think more commercially, help them prioritize, and move faster.

You'll work closely alongside the Head of Digital Products & Customer Experience, who leads customer-facing software solutions. Together you'll ensure our physical and digital products work seamlessly to deliver on our site intelligence vision. This isn't a maintenance role. We're scaling hard and need someone who can handle the chaos, help to build the right structure without slowing us down, and make the team better.

What You’ll Do

  • Implement & manage the product P&Ls. Business cases, revenue targets, product margins in collaboration with the Group Pricing Manager - the full commercial picture.
  • Build product lifecycle management processes that actually work at scale. Discovery, development, launch, optimization, end-of-life.
  • Coach a team of Product Owners & specialists. Make them better at commercial thinking, prioritization, and shipping. Develop future leaders (currently 8 individuals).
  • Set product strategy for hardware, embedded systems, and internal software that keeps our fleet running. Balance innovation with what customers need & sustaining engineering.
  • Partner with the Head of Digital Products & Customer Experience to ensure physical and digital products integrate seamlessly and deliver the full customer experience.
  • Drive new (physical) product launches across 11 countries. Work with Product Marketing, Sales, Ops, and Engineering to get products to market and make them successful.
  • Push the team on modern practices. AI tools, improve & implement processes, creative problem-solving. Question how we do things and make it better.


Job Requirements

 What we’re looking for

Requirements:

  • 8+ years in product, with 5+ years leading teams. Hardware, IoT, or embedded systems experience required.
  • You've run Product P&Ls before. You know how to make money, not just ship features.
  • High-growth experience. You've been through 30%+ annual growth, you know how to scale despite things breaking all the time
  • You're a coach, not a micromanager. You make people better and they want to work with you. You go deep, when needed, to ensure output quality
  • You understand hardware reality - supply chains, manufacturing constraints, field deployment. You can talk to engineers and translate it to business value.
  • You work well with peer leaders. You'll partner closely with the Head of Digital Products to create cohesive experiences across hardware and software.
  • Positive energy. You get excited about hard problems. Teams follow you and go the extra mile because they want to, not because they have to.
  • Fluent in English (C1/C2-level), additional languages are a plus. You'll be working across countries and need to communicate clearly.


What matters:

  • Bias for action over perfect plans
  • Commercial instinct - knowing what will actually make money
  • Building for scale, not just today
  • Making your team better, not just getting your own work done
  • Comfort with ambiguity and changing fast when needed
  • Willing to work - it’s a full-time role


What you can expect from us

  • Real impact. Construction sites are dangerous. We're building the intelligence to prevent incidents before they happen - both security and safety.
  • You'll shape how we scale. Not many people get to build product processes for a company growing this fast.
  • Leadership opportunity with full ownership. Product P&Ls, team, strategy.
  • Smart, driven people who care about getting things done.
  • Fast-paced environment where every day is different.


Logistics:

  • One-year contract, then extension with indefinite
  • Competitive salary + bonus
  • 25 vacation days (option to buy more)
  • Everything you need to be successful incl. Laptop, mobile, car, pension plan


Who we are

BauWatch is Europe's #1 in temporary security solutions, growing 30% YoY. We're in 11 countries, 44,000+ projects completed, and we're moving fast.

Our vision: “Zero incidence, faster delivery - through connected site intelligence that protects by design.”

We combine ruggedized monitoring towers, sensors, access control solutions, intelligent edge devices, fleet management, and 24/7 remote monitoring into a connected system. Construction and temporary sites are among the most dangerous work environments - we're building the intelligence to catch security and safety threats before they become incidents.

Interested?

If so please Apply with a cv and a salary expectation.

For questions or more information contact Ruud Licht, Group Recruitment Officer at +31 6 20172020.

title: Director, Product Management
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Director, Product Management.

About The Job

Twilio is looking for a Director, Product Management, to help deliver on our strategic vision for the Twilio Flex product that is part of the Twilio Platform. In this role, you will be responsible for the features, UI, APIs, Agentic approach, and documentation that powers the Flex product ecosystem. You will help define and drive the roadmap that enables internal teams, partners, third-party developers, and customers to innovate and scale their contact center solutions on Twilio. As a strategic leader, you collaborate closely with other product leaders, Engineering, Architecture, and Go-To-Market teams to deliver robust, scalable, and forward-looking Flex capabilities. As a leader and manager, you will manage and lead a team of strong individual Product Managers. And finally, as a key leader of the Twilio India location, you will help guide and shape the working experience of hundreds of other Twilions as you partner with senior leadership in Bangalore, India.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Define, build, and execute a comprehensive product roadmap for the foundational services, APIs, and developer infrastructure powering the Twilio Flex product ecosystem.
  • Lead the evolution of Twilio Flex from a standalone application into a set of decomposable, AI-native components, aligning with Twilio’s strategic platform vision.
  • Provide clear ownership, hands-on product management, managing roadmap execution, and operational oversight for the consolidated Flex Product Management team.
  • Manage and mentor a team of strong individual Product Managers, fostering a culture of technical rigor, continuous learning, and high performance.
  • Champion an outstanding customer experience by driving improvements in APIs, SDKs, documentation, and tooling for internal teams, partners, and external developers.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Architecture, Design, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver robust, scalable, and forward-looking Flex capabilities.

title: Head of Transformation - Product Management
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Position Summary

Lead the Transformation Team's track for a large-scale digital workplace and AI transformation. This role owns the design, staffing, sequencing, delivery, and business outcomes of small, time-bound, cross-functional teams that redesign how individual business functions work using collaboration technology, AI, and automation on top of approved platform capabilities. During the initial launch phase, this role also acts as the single delivery leader across the broader program.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and run the team operating model
  • Recruit, lead, and develop Transformation Team Leads
  • Own team intake and sequencing within platform readiness windows
  • Co-own the integrated master sequence with the Head of Platform
  • Define business outcomes and success metrics for each team with the relevant business sponsor
  • Drive workflow redesign, process simplification, AI-enabled tooling, and adoption across business functions
  • Enforce architectural compliance by ensuring teams build only on approved platform capabilities
  • Escalate missing capabilities rather than allowing workarounds or shadow solutions
  • Manage engineering demand from a shared engineering organization and resolve allocation issues within agreed governance
  • Escalate cross-track resource conflicts to executive program leadership
  • Partner with Enablement and Change on embedded change leadership
  • Partner with Security and Data Governance on required approvals for AI-enabled solutions
  • Own team lifecycle through formal sustainment handoff
  • Represent the program to senior business leaders
  • Deliver consolidated delivery reporting across teams


Decision Rights

Owns:

  • Team design, staffing, and sequencing within platform readiness windows
  • Team-level priorities
  • Intake acceptance and go or no-go decisions for business function engagement
  • Team success criteria, jointly with the business sponsor


Coordinates, but does not unilaterally decide:

  • Engineer allocation from the shared pool
  • Master sequencing with Platform
  • Shared partner capacity


Does not own:

  • Generic migration work or platform standards
  • Enterprise change management standards
  • Security, Data Governance, or legal approvals
  • Final enterprise operating model or overall strategy


Speaks for the Transformation Team's program on scope, delivery, and sequencing. Empowered to set team priorities and to accept or hold business function intake. Cross-track resource and sequencing conflicts escalate to executive program leadership.

Success Measures in the First 12 Months

  • Early teams deliver measurable workflow and productivity improvements on schedule
  • A repeatable team playbook and intake model is established
  • Sustainment handoffs are documented, complete, and free of orphaned tooling
  • Additional business functions actively request team support


Role Evolution

As the program scales, this role can evolve into a broader program leadership position with responsibility across both transformation tracks, while a dedicated Head of Transformation Teams is appointed to manage team leads day to day.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)

  • 12 to 15+ years in enterprise transformation, product leadership, or IT delivery, including large-scale change programs
  • Proven success leading cross-functional teams and managing product managers
  • Experience delivering enterprise SaaS, collaboration, automation, or AI transformations at scale
  • Strong executive presence with senior business leaders and external partners
  • Working knowledge of modern productivity platforms, AI workflow design, and change management
  • Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed organization and make sound tradeoff decisions around constrained resources


What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience defining and tracking value realization metrics, including adoption, productivity, control/compliance, and sustainment outcomes, for enterprise workflow transformation initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business needs into scalable, platform-aligned solutions that maximize reuse and avoid one-off tooling or shadow processes.
  • Experience establishing durable sustainment models, including operating procedures, documentation, ownership transitions, and post-launch governance for artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and collaboration solutions.
  • Experience leading a multi-team transformation portfolio, including dependency management, sequencing, and executive governance across concurrent workstreams.
  • Proven track record building and coaching product or transformation leaders in a matrixed, shared-services environment.


Compensation: The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. It is based on what a successful applicant might be paid in accordance with applicable state laws. The compensation may not be representative for positions located outside of the California Bay Area.

  • The salary range for this role is $178,800 to $322,500. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.
  • Bonus Potential: An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance


Benefits: GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation & holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more.

Company Vehicle: Upon successful completion of a motor vehicle report review, you will be eligible to participate in a company vehicle evaluation program, through which you will be assigned a General Motors vehicle to drive and evaluate. Note: program participants are required to purchase/lease a qualifying GM vehicle every four years unless one of a limited number of exceptions applies.

GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need GM immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc). This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the selected candidate is expected to report to a specific location at least 3 times a week {or other frequency dictated by their manager}. This job may be eligible for relocation benefits.

About GM

Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.

Why Join Us

We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.

Benefits Overview

From day one, we're looking out for your well-being–at work and at home–so you can focus on realizing your ambitions. Learn how GM supports a rewarding career that rewards you personally by visiting Total Rewards resources.

Non-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities (U.S.)

General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. We strongly believe that providing an inclusive workplace creates an environment in which our employees can thrive and develop better products for our customers.

All employment decisions are made on a non-discriminatory basis without regard to sex, race, color, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran or protected veteran, or any other similarly protected status in accordance with federal, state and local laws.

We encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for any positions that match their skills and capabilities. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role-related assessment(s) and/or a pre-employment screening prior to beginning employment. To learn more, visit How we Hire.

Accommodations

General Motors offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us or call us at 1-800-865-7580. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

title: Director, Crushing Products
descriptionHtml:
Director, Crushing Products 5/14/26 Lexington, Kentucky, USA, 40511 35845 Onsite Position

Join Komatsu and Be Part of Something Big!

Job Overview

  • Own Product Management Operating System & Portfolio
  • Accountable for establishing and enforcing the Crushing Product Management Operating Standard across the global portfolio, ensuring clear ownership, lifecycle management, profitability performance, and alignment to strategic growth objectives.
  • Lead Strategy, Roadmap & Lifecycle Management
  • Own development and execution of short and long-term product roadmaps aligned to strategic pillars, including new product development, product enhancements, and lifecycle management to drive growth, installed base expansion, and aftermarket performance.
  • Institutionalize Voice of Customer & Market-Driven Growth
  • Establish and enforce structured VOC processes translating field, dealer, and customer insights into validated roadmap actions, enabling diversification and expansion across mining, cement, aggregates, and industrial minerals.
  • Own Product Value, Competitiveness & TCO
  • Own product value, competitiveness, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), including structured competitive analysis to inform differentiation, pricing, and roadmap decisions.
  • Ensure Product Development, Testing & Validation
  • Lead and govern NPD execution, ensuring safety is a foundational design requirement in all products, validated through structured testing and reference site development for performance, reliability, and application fit.
  • Own Commercial Readiness & Go-To-Market Enablement
  • Ensure full commercial readiness across direct and dealer channels, including tools, training, and value messaging, enabling effective product adoption and sales execution.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Execution & Build High-Performance Teams
  • Lead, align, and develop Product Management and Applications teams while driving cross-functional execution across Business Development, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Product Support, and Finance.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Define & Understand the Portfolio
  • Product portfolio management including formal product definition, lifecycle tracking, and gap analysis
  • Own product competitiveness including TCO, margin, and differentiation
  • Ensure alignment between product capability, application requirements, and customer expectations, including validation of performance, specifications, and operating parameters.
  • Drive Market & Commercial Execution
  • Drive ongoing commercial readiness and training enablement across regions and dealers
  • Ensure new product launch readiness and post-launch performance tracking
  • Governance
  • Define and enforce the NPD governance framework as part of the Product Management Operating Standard, including prioritization, stage-gate discipline, and cross-functional alignment to ensure delivery of strategic and financial outcomes.
  • Provide product-level inputs to support forecasting accuracy, including lifecycle transitions, product availability, and demand-shaping factors.

Key Job Responsibities (continued)

  • Build & Validate the Product
  • Own and execute structured product validation plans, including field testing and reference site validation, ensuring product performance, reliability, and application fit are validated through real-world application.
  • Ensure validation results are documented, communicated, and integrated into product decisions, roadmap prioritization, and commercial messaging.
  • Enable Lifecycle Value
  • Ensure products are designed to support aftermarket growth by incorporating serviceability, parts strategy, and lifecycle considerations that enable Product Support to maximize installed base value and profitability.
  • Fund & Measure the System
  • Define and manage capital and development investment requirements, including CapEx for testing infrastructure, NPD funding, and demo/proving equipment, ensuring all investments prioritize safety, compliance, and risk mitigation while supporting validation and commercial success.
  • Ensure VOC pipeline execution and measurable response timelines
  • Lead quarterly Product Health Scorecard reviews across all product lines

Qualifications/Requirements

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in product management, engineering, commercial, or related roles within mining, construction, industrial, or capital equipment environments.
  • Demonstrates progressive experience owning a product line or portfolio, with clear accountability for performance, including revenue growth, margin improvement, and lifecycle management from introduction through phase-out.
  • Makes and owns trade-off decisions that impact product performance, balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, cost, and profitability.
  • Strong strategic thinking and business acumen, with the ability to translate market insights, customer needs, and financial objectives into actionable product strategies and measurable outcomes.
  • Possesses deep understanding of product application in real operating environments, connecting product design and performance to customer outcomes in the field.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and influencing cross-functional teams in a global environment, with a strong track record of collaboration across engineering, commercial, and operational functions.
  • Experience driving disciplined execution through structured processes, governance, and operating rhythms, with accountability for delivering results.
  • High level of emotional intelligence, including effective communication, active listening, and the ability to build trust and align diverse stakeholders.
  • Operates effectively in complex, global, or matrixed environments, navigating competing priorities while maintaining focus on strategic outcomes.
  • Experience from mining, construction, industrial, capital equipment, or similarly complex product environments where lifecycle performance and application fit are critical.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Additional Information

COLLABORATION

Working together with one or more people to complete a project or task or develop ideas or processes.

ADAPTABILITY

Having the ability to adjust to changes in their environment.

HUNTER MENTALITY

A combination of traits that can help someone achieve their goals with consistency and precision.

BUSINESS ACCUMEN

Having the ability to understand business situations and make sound decisions that lead to successful outcomes.

APPLICATION OF KNOWLEDGE

Being able to use what you’ve learned to make decisions and complete tasks in different situations.

LEADERSHIP

The ability to guide, influence or lead others to accomplish a shared goal.

Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

At Komatsu we come from diverse backgrounds, with unique perspectives, experiences, and contributions.  We are committed to creating a workforce that is reflective of the communities we work and live in. We believe that our people are part of our shared purpose.  We are authentic, ambitious, and innovative in our pursuit of Diversity & Inclusion. United, we are on a journey towards a sustainable future that creates value together. 

Company Information

Komatsu is a world leader in manufacturing construction, mining, forestry, and industrial heavy equipment. Founded in 1921, Komatsu has a long history of quality, reliability, innovation, and excellence. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Komatsu facilities, distributors and dealers are in more than 140 countries and employ more than 60,000 people. Komatsu offers a diverse and challenging work environment, where you can grow your skills and career, and contribute to a sustainable, clean-energy future. If you are looking for a company that values your talent and potential, be a part of something big and join a team that is shaping the world!

If you want to learn more about Komatsu, please visit our website at https://www.komatsu.com/ .

-  Own and execute structured product validation plans, including field testing and reference site validation, ensuring product performance, reliability, and application fit are validated through real-world application.
-  Ensure validation results are documented, communicated, and integrated into product decisions, roadmap prioritization, and commercial messaging.
-  Enable Lifecycle Value
-  Ensure products are designed to support aftermarket growth by incorporating serviceability, parts strategy, and lifecycle considerations that enable Product Support to maximize installed base value and profitability.
-  Fund & Measure the System
-  Define and manage capital and development investment requirements, including CapEx for testing infrastructure, NPD funding, and demo/proving equipment, ensuring all investments prioritize safety, compliance, and risk mitigation while supporting validation and commercial success.
-  Ensure VOC pipeline execution and measurable response timelines
-  Lead quarterly Product Health Scorecard reviews across all product lines

Qualifications/Requirements



-  12+ years of progressive experience in product management, engineering, commercial, or related roles within mining, construction, industrial, or capital equipment environments.
-  Demonstrates progressive experience owning a product line or portfolio, with clear accountability for performance, including revenue growth, margin improvement, and lifecycle management from introduction through phase-out.
-  Makes and owns trade-off decisions that impact product performance, balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, cost, and profitability.
-  Strong strategic thinking and business acumen, with the ability to translate market insights, customer needs, and financial objectives into actionable product strategies and measurable outcomes.
-  Possesses deep understanding of product application in real operating environments, connecting product design and performance to customer outcomes in the field.
-  Demonstrated experience leading and influencing cross-functional teams in a global environment, with a strong track record of collaboration across engineering, commercial, and operational functions.
-  Experience driving disciplined execution through structured processes, governance, and operating rhythms, with accountability for delivering results.
-  High level of emotional intelligence, including effective communication, active listening, and the ability to build trust and align diverse stakeholders.
-  Operates effectively in complex, global, or matrixed environments, navigating competing priorities while maintaining focus on strategic outcomes.
-  Experience from mining, construction, industrial, capital equipment, or similarly complex product environments where lifecycle performance and application fit are critical.
-  Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

title: Sr. Director, Product Management AI Experiences
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG, we’re driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future.

Vivint Smart Home, an NRG owned company, is a leading smart home company in the United States, dedicated to redefining the home experience with intelligent products and services. We find purpose in proactively protecting and keeping our customers connected to home, no matter where they are. Join the Smart Home team to create smarter, safer and more sustainable homes.

Position Summary: Sr. Director Product Management AI Experiences

In this vital leadership role, you will serve as the Senior Director of Product Management for AI Experiences, acting as the single-threaded technical product leader responsible for transforming Vivint’s smart home hardware into a proactive, intelligent ecosystem. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, you will serve as the organization's independent strategic engine for software intelligence. You will bridge the gap between complex machine learning architectures and delightful consumer interfaces, defining the experiences that allow the future home to work seamlessly on behalf of our customers—giving back time, keeping them safe, and saving them money.

This role requires a forward-looking product leader with a deep technical understanding of where AI and machine learning are going. You will be responsible for defining a multi-year vision and building "new-to-world" experiences that utilize ambient intelligence, predictive analytics, and computer vision across our entire hardware portfolio. You will lead a team of Technical Product Managers and collaborate with AI data scientists, platform engineers, and hardware architects to turn raw ambient telemetry into deeply personalized, high-value consumer offers.

Primary Responsibilities

Strategic AI Vision & 3-Year Roadmap

  • Next-Gen Experience Strategy: Own the definition, multi-year sequencing, and execution of the AI experience roadmap across the entire Vivint and NRG smart home portfolio.
  • Predictive Futures: Develop a comprehensive 3-year product roadmap rooted in a deep technical understanding of emerging AI/ML capabilities, translating future technological vectors into immediate, high-value customer benefits.
  • New-to-World Innovation: Autonomously identify, scope, and validate "white space" opportunities to deploy net-new, disruptive AI experiences that shift the smart home from a reactive state to an ambient, proactive state.

Ecosystem Intelligence & Technical Execution

  • Ecosystem Orchestration: Serve as the strategic thought leader on how disparate hardware endpoints (cameras, panels, sensors) and cloud platforms can leverage unified machine learning models to act as a singular, cohesive system.
  • Technical Deep-Dives: Author high-quality, data-driven narrative documents (PRFAQs, Working-Backwards documents, and 3-Year Operating Plans) to align senior executive leadership (VP+) on high-stakes AI investments, algorithm training requirements, and data privacy policies.
  • Data & AI Mechanisms: Define and scale cross-organizational mechanisms to continuously monitor model performance, customer usage telemetry, and behavioral data to rigorously refine and iterate on shipped experiences.

Leadership, Influence & Team Coaching

  • Team Management: Directly manage, mentor, and scale a lean team of high-performing Technical Product Managers, fostering a deep culture of technical excellence, algorithmic rigor, and extreme customer-centricity.
  • Matrixed Influence: Operate independently to influence, unblock, and align a highly cross-functional, multi-disciplinary organization spanning Data Science, AI/ML Platform Engineering, UX Design Language teams, and Hardware Product lines.
  • Execution Excellence: Translate complex machine learning capabilities into precise, unambiguous product requirement documents (PRDs), ensuring a reliable and ethical path from initial model training to mass-market production deployment.

Required Skills & Functional Dimensions

  • Autonomous AI Strategy: Proven ability to define long-term product frameworks and navigate intense ambiguity independently. You must be comfortable establishing a product path where technical baselines or data sets are completely undefined.
  • AI/ML Product Mastery: Deep technical literacy in applying machine learning approaches to consumer-facing ecosystems. Direct experience productizing capabilities like computer vision, edge-AI processing, natural language processing, or predictive behavioral modeling is required.
  • Ecosystem & Hardware Familiarity: Strong understanding of how software intelligence interacts with physical consumer hardware lifecycles, including ambient wireless frameworks, cloud latency constraints, and local device processing limitations.
  • Stakeholder Influence & Narrative Writing: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Proven track record of presenting complex data science and product concepts clearly to non-technical executive leadership to secure broad organizational alignment.

Required Education & Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of product management experience, with at least 5+ years dedicated specifically to shipping consumer-facing AI/ML software features, intelligent IoT experiences, or complex data-driven platforms at scale.
  • Technical Partnership Track Record: Demonstrated experience managing products that require close, daily coordination with AI data scientists, machine learning infrastructure engineers, and data privacy teams.
  • Leadership Track Record: 3+ years of experience directly managing and developing technical product professionals, with a proven ability to scale a team's technical capacity.
  • Education: B.S. or M.S. in a Technical Field (Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related discipline); MBA or equivalent business experience preferred.

The base salary range for this position is: $209,600 - $345,840* *The base salary range above represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include annual bonus, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards. In addition the position may be eligible to participate in the benefits program which include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending accounts.

NRG Energy is committed to a drug and alcohol-free workplace. To the extent permitted by law and any applicable collective bargaining agreement, employees are subject to periodic random drug testing, and post-accident and reasonable suspicion drug and alcohol testing. EOE AA M/F/Protected Veteran Status/Disability. Level, Title and/or Salary may be adjusted based on the applicant's experience or skills.

EEO is the Law Poster (The poster can be found at http://www.eeoc.gov/employers/upload/poster_screen_reader_optimized.pdf)

title: Senior Director of Product
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Director of Product based in Germany.

This role is a senior product leadership position responsible for defining and driving the vision, strategy, and execution of a global Employer of Record platform. You will own the end-to-end product experience across the entire employment lifecycle, ensuring seamless workflows that enable companies to hire, onboard, manage, and pay international talent at scale. The role sits at the intersection of product strategy, regulatory complexity, and operational execution, requiring a strong systems-thinking mindset. You will lead multiple Product Managers and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Go-To-Market teams. The environment is highly cross-functional, fast-evolving, and deeply mission-driven, with a strong emphasis on clarity, scalability, and measurable outcomes. This is a high-impact leadership role shaping both product direction and organizational execution standards across a global platform.

Accountabilities

  • Own the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and performance for the Employer of Record platform, ensuring alignment with company objectives and measurable customer outcomes.
  • Lead and scale multiple Product Managers, setting high standards for product discovery, execution, and delivery quality.
  • Translate strategic priorities into clear roadmaps, success metrics, and scalable execution plans across multiple product domains.
  • Drive prioritization across competing initiatives including new features, regulatory requirements, technical debt, and platform improvements.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional product initiatives requiring alignment across Engineering, Design, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders to ensure the product supports broader business goals, including growth, efficiency, and margin improvement.
  • Use data, insights, and customer feedback to inform decision-making and continuously improve product outcomes.
  • Foster an AI-first, high-performance product culture focused on speed, scalability, and operational excellence.
  • Represent the product domain at executive level, clearly communicating strategy, trade-offs, risks, and impact.
  • Build and develop a high-performing, remote-first product organization and contribute to broader product best practices.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in Product Management, including at least 5+ years in leadership roles managing Product Managers.
  • Strong experience in HR tech, EoR, payroll, compliance, or complex B2B SaaS environments.
  • Proven ability to define and communicate product vision and strategy tied to business and customer outcomes.
  • Strong systems-thinking mindset with experience translating complex regulatory or operational requirements into scalable product solutions.
  • Demonstrated success leading multi-team product organizations in high-growth or scale-up environments.
  • Excellent leadership skills with a track record of hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing product talent.
  • Strong product discovery and problem-framing skills, with the ability to turn ambiguity into structured execution plans.
  • Highly data-driven with strong analytical skills and comfort making decisions based on metrics and insights.
  • Experience driving AI-enabled or automation-focused product initiatives is strongly valued.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at executive level.

Benefits

  • Competitive global salary benchmarked to senior product leadership roles
  • Fully remote work with flexible location across Spain and EMEA time zones
  • Generous paid time off (including extended annual leave allowances)
  • Flexible working culture with async-first collaboration practices
  • Comprehensive mental health and wellbeing support programs
  • Home office setup and monthly wellbeing allowance
  • Paid parental leave with strong job protection policies
  • Learning and development budget for continuous growth
  • Opportunity to work on a global, high-impact platform shaping the future of employment infrastructure
  • Inclusive, mission-driven culture focused on trust, autonomy, and impact

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Sr. Director, Product Management AI Experiences
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG, we’re driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future.

Vivint Smart Home, an NRG owned company, is a leading smart home company in the United States, dedicated to redefining the home experience with intelligent products and services. We find purpose in proactively protecting and keeping our customers connected to home, no matter where they are. Join the Smart Home team to create smarter, safer and more sustainable homes.

Position Summary: Sr. Director Product Management AI Experiences

In this vital leadership role, you will serve as the Senior Director of Product Management for AI Experiences, acting as the single-threaded technical product leader responsible for transforming Vivint’s smart home hardware into a proactive, intelligent ecosystem. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, you will serve as the organization's independent strategic engine for software intelligence. You will bridge the gap between complex machine learning architectures and delightful consumer interfaces, defining the experiences that allow the future home to work seamlessly on behalf of our customers—giving back time, keeping them safe, and saving them money.

This role requires a forward-looking product leader with a deep technical understanding of where AI and machine learning are going. You will be responsible for defining a multi-year vision and building "new-to-world" experiences that utilize ambient intelligence, predictive analytics, and computer vision across our entire hardware portfolio. You will lead a team of Technical Product Managers and collaborate with AI data scientists, platform engineers, and hardware architects to turn raw ambient telemetry into deeply personalized, high-value consumer offers.

Primary Responsibilities

Strategic AI Vision & 3-Year Roadmap

  • Next-Gen Experience Strategy: Own the definition, multi-year sequencing, and execution of the AI experience roadmap across the entire Vivint and NRG smart home portfolio.
  • Predictive Futures: Develop a comprehensive 3-year product roadmap rooted in a deep technical understanding of emerging AI/ML capabilities, translating future technological vectors into immediate, high-value customer benefits.
  • New-to-World Innovation: Autonomously identify, scope, and validate "white space" opportunities to deploy net-new, disruptive AI experiences that shift the smart home from a reactive state to an ambient, proactive state.

Ecosystem Intelligence & Technical Execution

  • Ecosystem Orchestration: Serve as the strategic thought leader on how disparate hardware endpoints (cameras, panels, sensors) and cloud platforms can leverage unified machine learning models to act as a singular, cohesive system.
  • Technical Deep-Dives: Author high-quality, data-driven narrative documents (PRFAQs, Working-Backwards documents, and 3-Year Operating Plans) to align senior executive leadership (VP+) on high-stakes AI investments, algorithm training requirements, and data privacy policies.
  • Data & AI Mechanisms: Define and scale cross-organizational mechanisms to continuously monitor model performance, customer usage telemetry, and behavioral data to rigorously refine and iterate on shipped experiences.

Leadership, Influence & Team Coaching

  • Team Management: Directly manage, mentor, and scale a lean team of high-performing Technical Product Managers, fostering a deep culture of technical excellence, algorithmic rigor, and extreme customer-centricity.
  • Matrixed Influence: Operate independently to influence, unblock, and align a highly cross-functional, multi-disciplinary organization spanning Data Science, AI/ML Platform Engineering, UX Design Language teams, and Hardware Product lines.
  • Execution Excellence: Translate complex machine learning capabilities into precise, unambiguous product requirement documents (PRDs), ensuring a reliable and ethical path from initial model training to mass-market production deployment.

Required Skills & Functional Dimensions

  • Autonomous AI Strategy: Proven ability to define long-term product frameworks and navigate intense ambiguity independently. You must be comfortable establishing a product path where technical baselines or data sets are completely undefined.
  • AI/ML Product Mastery: Deep technical literacy in applying machine learning approaches to consumer-facing ecosystems. Direct experience productizing capabilities like computer vision, edge-AI processing, natural language processing, or predictive behavioral modeling is required.
  • Ecosystem & Hardware Familiarity: Strong understanding of how software intelligence interacts with physical consumer hardware lifecycles, including ambient wireless frameworks, cloud latency constraints, and local device processing limitations.
  • Stakeholder Influence & Narrative Writing: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Proven track record of presenting complex data science and product concepts clearly to non-technical executive leadership to secure broad organizational alignment.

Required Education & Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of product management experience, with at least 5+ years dedicated specifically to shipping consumer-facing AI/ML software features, intelligent IoT experiences, or complex data-driven platforms at scale.
  • Technical Partnership Track Record: Demonstrated experience managing products that require close, daily coordination with AI data scientists, machine learning infrastructure engineers, and data privacy teams.
  • Leadership Track Record: 3+ years of experience directly managing and developing technical product professionals, with a proven ability to scale a team's technical capacity.
  • Education: B.S. or M.S. in a Technical Field (Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related discipline); MBA or equivalent business experience preferred.

The base salary range for this position is: $209,600 - $345,840* *The base salary range above represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include annual bonus, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards. In addition the position may be eligible to participate in the benefits program which include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending accounts.

NRG Energy is committed to a drug and alcohol-free workplace. To the extent permitted by law and any applicable collective bargaining agreement, employees are subject to periodic random drug testing, and post-accident and reasonable suspicion drug and alcohol testing. EOE AA M/F/Protected Veteran Status/Disability. Level, Title and/or Salary may be adjusted based on the applicant's experience or skills.

title: Director of Product, Reach Demand (AdTech)
descriptionHtml:
Director of Product, Reach Demand (AdTech)


Samsung Ads, the advertising monetization arm of Samsung Electronics, leverages proprietary Samsung TV / mobile usage data and insights to promote relevant brands and consumer content experiences. We partner with brands, agencies and content owners to deliver unique advertising opportunities on native placements within our Smart TV platform and programmatically. Samsung’s unique first-party data helps brands connect to their audience as they explore content across desktop, mobile, tablets, and our Smart TVs. The Samsung Ads platform delivers high-quality audience targeting powered by three key components: first-party audience data at scale, world-class data science, and brand-safe, cross-device ad inventory.


We are looking for a high-performing individual to join the Reach Demand product team to develop and drive monetization of upper funnel advertising solutions. You will partner with cross-functional global teams, external partners, and customers to identify opportunities to exceed customer objectives and grow product revenue and margin. This is a high-visibility role with growth potential and high impact. We believe in building a best-in-class, enterprise-grade product and creating a new industry standard. Join us in this exciting ride!


Role and Responsibilities


  • Define and own the product vision and roadmap for upper funnel reach solutions supporting our brand and media/entertainment advertisers with an emphasis on contextual relevance, attention optimization, and incrementality
  • Identify market trends and opportunities, ensuring solutions address client pain points and define a product strategy that prioritizes agility and scalability, adapting to the dynamic needs of our advertisers in driving full funnel marketing outcomes, leveraging Samsung Ads
  • Work closely with sales, business stakeholders and advertisers to understand their upper funnel brand awareness and reach goals and translate client feedback into actionable product features that enhance user engagement, session continuity, and advertising efficiency.
  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of upper funnel reach solutions built from the ground up by collaborating with engineering, design, and data science teams to incorporate Samsung's rich 1st party data and advanced machine learning models to deliver high-quality, innovative product features.
  • Operate in an agile, iterative environment to prototype, test, and rapidly improve product offerings and advocate for data-driven insights to enhance product performance and scalability.
  • Communicate the strategy, plans and progress to stakeholders in different geographies and business units and identify new opportunities for extending products and features


Skills and Qualifications


  • 10+ years in product management, with a specialization in reach and brand awareness solutions; including 6+ years in AdTech experience
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with engineering and data science teams to integrate machine learning into products for the AdTech companies is highly preferred.
  • Proven track record of building and scaling products from zero to one in fast-paced, agile environments and proficiency in leveraging data to inform product decisions and drive measurable results.
  • Excellent communication skills and experience working effectively with globally distributed teams, managing cross-functional stakeholders and having the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; master’s degree or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Proficiency in basic data analysis using tools such as Excel, SQL and the ability to understand and discuss technical concepts and evaluate tradeoffs with engineering


Compensation for this role, for candidates based in Mountain View, CA is expected to be between $220,000 ~ $260,000 base. Actual pay will be determined considering factors such as relevant skills and experience, and comparison to other employees in the role. Regular full-time employees (salaried or hourly) have access to benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, 401(k), Employee Purchase Program, Tuition Assistance (after 6 months), Paid Time Off, Student Loan Program (after 6 months), Wellness Incentives, and many more.

title: Sr. Director of Product Management
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Director of Product Management based in the United States.

This is a senior leadership role responsible for defining and executing the product strategy for a portfolio of mission-driven SaaS solutions that support public safety organizations.

You will shape multi-year product vision, drive portfolio growth, and ensure products deliver measurable impact for customers in highly regulated, real-world environments.

The role blends strategic leadership, people management, and hands-on product oversight across the full lifecycle from discovery to launch and iteration.

You will lead and scale a team of product managers and technical product owners, setting the bar for product excellence and organizational execution.

A key part of the role involves partnering with executive leadership to align product strategy with business objectives, revenue goals, and market opportunities.

You will also collaborate closely with engineering, design, marketing, and customer success to ensure strong execution and market adoption.

This is a high-visibility role with direct influence on both company direction and outcomes for first responders nationwide.

Accountabilities

You will be responsible for leading product strategy, portfolio execution, and team development while ensuring strong alignment between market needs, business goals, and product delivery.

  • Define and own the multi-year product strategy for the Policy product portfolio, ensuring alignment with company growth objectives and market needs.
  • Lead competitive analysis, customer research, and market segmentation to identify new opportunities and inform strategic direction.
  • Develop product positioning, messaging, and pricing strategies in partnership with product marketing and executive leadership.
  • Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of product managers and technical product owners.
  • Establish standards for product management practices, including discovery, requirements definition, delivery, and measurement.
  • Own portfolio roadmap prioritization, balancing short-term revenue goals with long-term strategic growth.
  • Oversee product development processes, including alpha/beta programs, KPI tracking, and release validation.
  • Collaborate with sales, marketing, engineering, and customer success to drive go-to-market execution and product adoption.
  • Build business cases for new product investments and evaluate ROI for strategic initiatives and partnerships.

Requirements

The ideal candidate is an experienced product leader with a strong SaaS background, proven ability to manage teams, and a track record of driving portfolio-level strategy in complex markets.

  • 10-15 years of SaaS product management experience, including 3-5+ years in senior leadership roles managing product teams.
  • Proven experience defining and executing portfolio-level product strategy in B2B or B2G environments.
  • Strong background in pricing strategy, product positioning, and competitive market analysis.
  • Experience building and presenting executive-level strategy to C-suite stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills with ability to define KPIs, build business cases, and translate data into strategy.
  • Deep understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and product development lifecycle best practices.
  • Experience leading, developing, and scaling high-performing product organizations.
  • Familiarity with integrating AI capabilities into product strategy or product development.
  • Experience in public safety, government, or regulated industries is a strong plus.
  • MBA or relevant certifications (Agile, SAFe, PMI-ACP, Pragmatic Marketing) are a plus.

Benefits

  • Base salary starting at $175,000+ depending on experience
  • Annual performance-based bonus
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Remote-first work environment with core collaboration hours
  • High-impact executive visibility and leadership exposure
  • Opportunity to shape product strategy at portfolio and organizational level
  • Mission-driven work supporting public safety professionals and first responders
  • Comprehensive benefits package including health coverage and wellness support

title: Head of Product - AI/ML
descriptionHtml:
Inception creates the world’s fastest, most efficient AI models. Our Mercury model is the world’s fastest reasoning LLM and first commercially available diffusion LLM, delivering 5x greater speed and efficiency than today’s LLMs, with best-in-class quality.


We are the AI researchers and engineers behind such breakthrough AI technologies as diffusion models, flash attention, and DPO.


The Role

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer and working closely with the founding team, this role provides an opportunity to own and define Inception’s product direction. As the Head of Product Management, you'll synthesize customer needs, ecosystem trends, and breakthrough AI research into products that transform how millions of users work, create, and solve problems.


This role requires a leader who’s comfortable driving innovation in uncharted territory, where the very nature of what's possible with AI is being redefined every day.


The ideal candidate is a data‑driven, customer‑centric product builder who operates comfortably at the intersection of advanced AI research and pragmatic product delivery. They have shipped 0→1 products, scaled 1→N, and are credible with highly technical teams. They bring strong judgment in fast‑changing environments, communicate crisply with executives and partners, and can translate subtle user needs into instant‑speed experiences.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end product lifecycle from strategy through launch
  • Conduct user research and analyze performance metrics specific to AI model behaviors and map these onto emerging use cases
  • Lead cross‑functional execution across Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and Go-to-Market teams.
  • Help design evaluation systems and live benchmarks to track and improve speed and quality in target use cases
  • Set performance targets that connect model capabilities to user needs.
  • Partner with early customers to prove value in target use cases and convert pilots into repeatable product bets.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Extensive track record of driving product initiatives in rapidly changing technical landscapes and translating large and diverse sets of feature requests and feedback into product feature definitions
  • Comfortable reading and writing code: able to prototype, explore APIs, and work closely with engineering teams


Preferred Experience

  • Experience conducting user research and interviews
  • Deep knowledge of LLMs at the modeling or application layer
  • Experience working in a startup and scaling products from early stage to growth phase


Compensation

The annual base salary range for this role is $200,000 – $350,000 USD. Final compensation is determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications. Equity and benefits are included in the total package.


Why Join Inception

  • Work with World-Class Talent: Collaborate with the inventors of diffusion models and leading AI researchers
  • Shape Foundational Technology: Your decisions will influence how the next generation of AI products are built and used
  • Immediate Impact: Join at the ground floor where your contributions directly shape product direction and company trajectory


Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity in a rapidly growing startup
  • Flexible vacation and paid time off (PTO)
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401k match
  • Catered meals (breakfast, lunch, & dinner)
  • Commuter subsidies
  • A collaborative and inclusive culture


About Us

Inception creates the world’s fastest, most efficient AI models. Today’s autoregressive LLMs generate tokens sequentially, which makes them painfully slow and expensive. Inception’s diffusion-based LLMs (dLLMs) generate answers in parallel. They are 5x faster and more efficient, while delivering best-in-class quality.


Inception was co-founded by Stanford professor Stefano Ermon, who co-invented such breakthrough AI technologies as diffusion models, flash attention, and DPO, UCLA professor Aditya Grover, who co-invented node2vec, decision transformers, and d1 reasoning, and Cornell professor and Afresh co-founder Volodymyr Kuleshov, who co-invented MDLM and Block Diffusion.


We pioneered the application of diffusion to language, with world’s first (and only) commercially available dLLM, Mercury. We are currently deploying our large-scale diffusion LLMs at Fortune 500 companies. Diffusion is the technology behind today’s image and video AI, and we’re making it the standard for LLMs as well.


Our team includes engineers from AWS, Google DeepMind, Meta AI, Microsoft, HashiCorp, and OpenAI. Based in Palo Alto, CA, we are backed by top-tier venture capitalists, including Menlo Ventures, Mayfield, M12 (Microsoft’s venture fund), Snowflake Ventures, Databricks, and Innovation Endeavors, and by tech luminaries such as Andrew Ng, Andrej Karpathy, and Eric Schmidt.


If you are talented, innovative, and ambitious, come help us invent the future of AI.

We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Product Director  (Saas)
descriptionHtml:
Product Director



Our client is seeking an experienced Product Director to lead a large product management function and play a pivotal role in shaping the future direction of their product portfolio.

This is a highly strategic leadership opportunity for a proven product executive who combines strong people leadership, operational excellence and commercial thinking. The successful candidate will lead a team of senior Product Managers, drive product management maturity across the organisation, and ensure product strategy remains tightly connected to customer needs, business outcomes and market opportunities.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, the Product Director will be responsible for driving strategic product initiatives and partnering closely with executive stakeholders across Technology, Commercial, Customer and Operations functions.

The successful candidate will also play a key role in shaping how the organisation evolves its products and customer experiences in an increasingly AI-driven market. Working closely with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success teams, you will help define and execute go-to-market strategies that drive product adoption, customer growth and commercial success.

About You

You are an accomplished product leader with significant experience leading product organisations within B2B SaaS or enterprise software businesses.

You bring:

* A proven track record of leading and developing teams of senior Product Managers, ideally managing teams of 5-10 or more

* Experience partnering with executive leadership teams to influence strategy and drive organisational outcomes

* Strong experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies for SaaS products, including product launches, market positioning and growth initiatives

* Commercial acumen and an understanding of how product decisions drive customer acquisition, retention and revenue outcomes

* The ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, evolving environments

* A clear perspective on emerging technology trends and the future role of AI in product strategy and customer experience

* Excellent communication, leadership and influencing capabilities

Industry Experience

Experience within accounting, tax, legal or financial services SaaS is essential.

Candidates whose experience is primarily within consumer-focused product organisations are unlikely to be a strong fit.

Why This Role?

This is a rare opportunity to influence the strategic direction of a market-leading software business and lead a significant product organisation during a period of transformation and growth. You will work alongside an experienced executive team, shape the future product vision, and play a critical role in delivering meaningful outcomes for customers and the business.

Please note that candidates who have not previously operated at Product Director level within a comparable B2B SaaS business in the accounting, tax, legal or financial services software sector will unfortunately not be considered for this opportunity.
