title: Head of Product & Business
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Head of Product & Business to lead Diggspace, our SaaS platform focused on digital workplace transformation, internal communication, employee engagement, and Microsoft 365 adoption.


This is a leadership role for someone who wants to combine product strategy, business growth, market positioning, customer insight, and commercial execution into a single coherent direction.


You will be responsible for transforming market opportunities, customer needs, Microsoft ecosystem evolution, and business objectives into a clear product vision, a focused roadmap, and measurable business outcomes.


Reporting directly to the leadership team, you will own the overall success of Diggspace across product, market, customer, and business dimensions. Working closely with engineering, sales, customer success, marketing, partners, and leadership, you will drive the next stage of Diggspace's growth while ensuring that product investments, customer value, market opportunities, and commercial priorities remain aligned.


This is not a traditional Product Manager role.


This is an opportunity to lead a growing SaaS business, influence strategy, shape market perception, and create meaningful impact on customers, partners, and the future of the product.


Why this role is different


Diggspace operates with a lean, high-accountability model where ownership matters more than hierarchy.


As Head of Product & Business, you will have significant autonomy to shape product direction, business priorities, market positioning, growth initiatives, and customer value creation. You will be empowered to make decisions, challenge assumptions, and drive outcomes that directly influence the future of the product.


At the same time, you will not be operating alone.


You will work closely with a leadership team whose combined experience spans technology entrepreneurship, SaaS product development, business growth, digital transformation, marketing, communications, and the Microsoft ecosystem. Together, they bring decades of practical experience building and operation technology companies, launching and evolving software products, developing go-to-market strategies, building brands, scaling customer relationships, and helping organizations drive adoption and value from Microsoft-based workplace solutions. Their experience includes the creation and growth of both services and SaaS businesses serving enterprise customers across multiple markets, as well as leading communication, engagement, and change initiatives within complex organizational environments.


On a quarterly basis, you will present product, customer, commercial, and strategic progress to the leadership team, gaining access to valuable experience, strategic guidance, constructive challenge, and mentorship while maintaining clear ownership of execution and results.


This combination of autonomy, accountability, and access to experienced leadership creates a unique opportunity for someone looking to accelerate both their impact and professional growth.


Tasks

What you will do:


Product Strategy & Leadership



  • Define and evolve the Diggspace product vision.

  • Own roadmap priorities, balancing customer value, business impact, technical constraints, and market opportunities.

  • Translate strategic goals into clear product outcomes and initiatives.

  • Drive product prioritization decisions based on measurable business and customer impact.

  • Make final recommendations on roadmap priorities, scope decisions, and major product trade-offs.

  • Validate product outcomes through adoption, engagement, retention, and business impact metrics.

  • Ensure alignment between business goals and product investments.

  • Work closely with engineering to ensure focus, quality, and execution excellence.


Business Growth & Commercial Strategy



  • Own Diggspace growth objectives together with leadership.

  • Drive initiatives that contribute to revenue growth, retention, expansion, and long-term customer value.

  • Review pipeline performance, forecasts, customer health, expansion opportunities, and churn risks.

  • Contribute to pricing, packaging, and commercial strategy decisions.

  • Identify and develop strategic partnerships and ecosystem opportunities.

  • Ensure that product strategy supports sustainable SaaS growth.


Market Positioning & Go-to-Market



  • Define positioning, messaging, and market differentiation.

  • Shape Diggspace's narrative around employee engagement, digital workplace transformation, Microsoft 365 adoption, organizational alignment, and the future of work.

  • Support sales and marketing activities with clear value propositions and strategic messaging.

  • Monitor customer needs, market trends, competitors, and Microsoft ecosystem developments.

  • Represent Diggspace in strategic customer, partner, analyst, and market conversations.


Customer & Partner Leadership



  • Maintain close engagement with customers and partners to understand needs, challenges, and opportunities.

  • Transform customer insights into product and business priorities.

  • Support strategic customer conversations and executive stakeholder engagement.

  • Act as escalation point for sensitive customer, product, or reputational matters.

  • Ensure a strong customer experience as the business scales.


Governance & Leadership Exposure



  • Lead monthly business, product, and customer performance reviews.

  • Present quarterly business and product reviews to the leadership team.

  • Share progress, challenges, opportunities, roadmap evolution, and growth initiatives.

  • Leverage the experience and perspective of senior leaders with extensive experience in building, scaling and operating businesses.

  • Contribute to strategic discussions regarding growth, market expansion, partnerships, investment priorities, and business evolution.

  • Maintain ownership of execution while benefiting from regular strategic guidance and executive-level feedback.


Requirements

What we value


Relax! There is no such thing as the perfect candidate.


We value people who bring different experiences, perspectives, and strengths. We are more interested in your ability to learn, adapt, lead, and create impact than in checking every box.


That said, we believe this role could be a great fit if you have:



  • Experience in B2B SaaS product leadership, product management, business leadership, or go-to-market strategy.

  • Strong understanding of SaaS growth drivers, including acquisition, adoption, retention, expansion, pricing, and customer value.

  • Ability to connect product decisions with business outcomes.

  • Experience working with enterprise customers and complex stakeholder environments.

  • Strong strategic thinking combined with execution capability.

  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.

  • Customer-centric mindset and commercial awareness.

  • Strong analytical and decision-making capabilities.

  • Ability to thrive in a lean, fast-moving environment with high ownership.

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Microsoft 365 experience is highly valued


Diggspace is deeply connected to the Microsoft ecosystem and helps organizations maximize the value of Microsoft 365 investments.


For that reason, we place particular value on candidates who bring experience, knowledge, or genuine interest in areas such as:



  • Microsoft 365

  • SharePoint Online

  • Microsoft Teams

  • Microsoft Viva

  • Employee Experience platforms

  • Internal Communications

  • Digital Workplace solutions

  • Employee Engagement initiatives

  • Change Management and Adoption programs

  • Organizational Transformation

  • Microsoft partner ecosystems


You do not need to be a Microsoft technical specialist. However, candidates who understand how organizations use Microsoft 365 to improve communication, engagement, productivity, and employee experience will have a significant advantage.


Experience working within Microsoft partners, Microsoft-focused consultancies, Modern Work practices, Employee Experience initiatives, digital workplace programs, or Microsoft 365 adoption and change management projects will be considered a strong differentiator.


You will probably enjoy this role if you



  • Want to lead a product and not just manage a backlog.

  • Enjoy combining product, business, customer, and commercial perspectives.

  • Like making decisions and taking ownership of outcomes.

  • Are motivated by growth, impact, and continuous learning.

  • Enjoy working directly with customers and understanding real business problems.

  • Believe that great products emerge from a deep understanding of both market needs and business realities.

  • Are curious about the future of work, employee experience, AI, and digital workplace transformation.

  • Want to help organizations create more engaging, aligned, and productive workplaces.


About Diggspace


Diggspace is a SaaS platform that helps organizations create engaging digital workplaces that increases Microsoft 365 adoption, improving communication, collaboration and knowledge sharing.


By combining content, business context, employee experience, and AI-powered capabilities, Diggspace helps organizations create stronger alignment, higher engagement, and better execution at scale.


About Create IT


Create IT is a technology company with more than 20 years of experience delivering innovative digital solutions and software products.


We are people-focused, collaborative, flexible, and driven by innovation. We invest in learning, certifications, knowledge sharing, and professional development because we believe great companies are built by people who continuously grow.


We value curiosity, ownership, teamwork, and the willingness to continuously improve both ourselves and the products we build.


What we offer



  • The opportunity to lead and shape a growing SaaS product with real market traction.

  • Significant autonomy and ownership over product and business decisions.

  • Direct exposure to experienced business and technology leaders.

  • The opportunity to influence product strategy, commercial growth, and market positioning.

  • A collaborative, informal, and low-ego working environment.

  • Flexible working arrangements.

  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.

  • Access to Microsoft-focused expertise, customers, partners, and innovation initiatives.

  • The opportunity to help define the future of employee engagement and digital workplace transformation.


Interested?


If this sounds like the kind of challenge you are looking for, we would love to hear from you.


Send us your application and tell us why you believe you could help shape the future of Diggspace.

title: Head of Engineering & Product
descriptionHtml:
Linkedin: www.linkedin.com/company/mindfriend/

Website: mindfriend.com/

MindFriend

  • Remote (UK/EU hours)
  • Full-time


We're looking for our senior engineering and product leader who will take MindFriend safely to launch and build the platform, and the team, that come after.

MindFriend is a mental-health marketplace connecting people with verified, licensed clinicians for online therapy: search, booking, payments, and live video, audio and chat sessions in one place. The platform is built and largely working, with a capable lead developer and a team. We're now bringing in the senior leader who will set the engineering bar, decide when we're ready to launch, and grow both the platform and the team from there with a level of ownership only the earliest team members ever get.

This role carries more weight than most engineering jobs. We handle sensitive health data and host live therapy sessions, so reliability and security aren't features they are the trust the entire category depends on. The person who gets this right will have real authority to do it properly, and will help shape what MindFriend becomes.

A word of honesty

This is a founding-team role at an early-stage company, which means it is hands-on. You will get into the code. You will run the QA passes yourself. You will test a video session on a bad connection at 9pm because a launch depends on it. You will make calls with incomplete information and live with them. You'll lead a small team and a freelance bench but you'll lead by doing, not just directing. If you want a purely strategic seat with people beneath you to execute, this is the wrong role. If you want to own the hardest, most consequential technical problems in the company and see them through, read on.

Requirements

What you'll be responsible for

  • The launch decision setting the readiness bar, and holding launch until it's met
  • Reliability of live video, audio and chat sessions on a user's old laptop and a clinician's poor wifi, not just a developer's machine
  • Security and privacy of sensitive health data the controls that keep us defensible, and an independent security review before we go live
  • End-to-end quality of the booking-and-payments flow, including the failure paths most teams skip
  • The product direction after launch what we build next, in what order, and why
  • Leading and growing the engineering and product team

What Success Looks Like

In your first weeks — to launch:

  • Own and close out the launch readiness bar; get MindFriend live in its first market with confidence, not crossed fingers
  • Pass an independent security review with critical findings remediated before go-live
  • Prove the full booking-to-session flow end-to-end, including every failure path, across real devices and networks

In your first 6-12 months:

  • Turn a freelance-built platform into a maintainable, well-owned codebase with a team to match
  • Establish a sane delivery cadence and the engineering and product processes we'll scale on
  • Set the post-launch roadmap and start shipping against it

Who You Are

  • 8+ years building software, with senior or lead engineering experience and you've carried real product responsibility, not just executed someone else's spec
  • You've shipped a consumer product that takes real payments and handles sensitive personal data, to production and through real users
  • You've worked somewhere the security and data bar is real health-tech, fintech, or similar. You're not learning why it matters here
  • You can run a security review and stand up the controls behind it yourself, not just brief someone else to
  • Hands-on operator first, leader second: you lead through doing
  • You work directly and candidly with a non-technical founder

A bonus, not a requirement: you've been part of an early-stage or founding team before and know how to operate without much process; marketplace or telehealth experience; multi-jurisdiction products; or having taken a product through SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / GDPR.

Why this role matters

In a category built on trust, the technical decisions are the business. Whether a session holds, whether data stays safe, whether the platform feels solid that's what earns the trust everything else depends on. As a founding-team member you'll build the foundation MindFriend grows on, and shape the company from its first day live. This is a rare chance to own the technical heart of a company at the moment it matters most

Benefits

What we offer

A founding-team seat working directly to the founder, with real authority and real ownership of the problems that matter most. A product that's already built and a launch to drive, not a blank page. Competitive cash compensation plus equity, reflecting the seniority and ownership of the role. And a mission worth the work making trustworthy mental-health support easier to find.

How To Apply

Write to us one short story: a product you took to launch that handled payments or sensitive data what you were responsible for, and what nearly went wrong. We value substance over polish; tell us what you've built, not just where you've worked.

title: Director, Product Management - Commercial & International Growth
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About The Team

Fanatics Collectibles is building the future of trading cards and scaling fast. Our licenses span MLB, NBA, NFL, Premier League, UEFA, WWE, UFC, and more. To power this growth, we're modernizing Topps, one of the most storied brands in sports and entertainment collectibles. As trading cards evolve from a nearly 100-year-old analog craft into a technology-driven, global business, we are rebuilding the systems that power how cards are sold, priced, and distributed across a complex global commercial ecosystem.

We are hiring a Director of Product Management to own the commercial product portfolio that drives revenue growth, pricing intelligence, financial planning, and international expansion across Fanatics Collectibles. This is a senior people-leadership role with endto-end accountability for the product strategy and execution that powers how Topps goes to market.

What You'll Do

  • Own the end-to-end product portfolio that powers commercial growth, including the internal enterprise systems that drive sales, pricing, customer intelligence, financial planning, and global market expansion.
  • Set the product strategy for how Fanatics Collectibles grows B2B revenue, defends margin, and expands into priority international markets.
  • Drive international expansion as a cross-functional product effort, going beyond feature localization to define the operating model, tooling, and partner integrations needed to make new geographies successful from launch through scale.
  • Build and scale the Finance product portfolio that powers FP&A, planning cycles, and revenue projections, in deep partnership with the CFO organization.
  • Develop a high-performing product team through hands-on coaching, clear performance standards, and deliberate investment in PMs' growth into senior operators.
  • Lead communications and stakeholder management with senior leadership across the commercial organization.
  • Apply AI and automation across the portfolio, identifying high-leverage opportunities to remove manual work, accelerate decision-making, and unlock new commercial capabilities (e.g., intelligent pricing, seller insights, predictive allocation).
  • Operate as a senior leader within the Product organization, contributing to org-wide strategy, hiring, and culture, and representing the commercial portfolio at the executive level.

What We're Looking For

  • 10 to 15 years of product management experience, including 3 to 5+ years in a senior product leadership role (Director or equivalent) with direct people management responsibility.
  • Demonstrated success building and scaling enterprise sales, pricing, or finance-adjacent product portfolios, ideally in industries with complex go-to-market motions, multi-channel distribution, or global operations.
  • Track record of leading international expansion work, including the operational, financial, and GTM complexity that comes with new market entry.
  • Strong technical fluency and an ability to partner effectively with leaders across engineering, data science, and analytics.
  • Executive presence and excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to clearly and confidently engage at the C-suite level.
  • Experience leading through growth, ambiguity, and change, particularly in organizations undergoing digital transformation, platform modernization, or international expansion.
  • Passion for trading cards and collectibles, or a demonstrated eagerness to become a world-class expert in this space. Deep curiosity and commitment to mastering this domain is essential.

Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don’t fall victim to fraud. Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including @collectfanatics.com). For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at www.fanaticsinc.com/careers

The salary range represents base pay only and does not include short-term or long-term incentive compensation. This salary range is specific to Los Angeles and may not be applicable to other locations. When determining base pay, as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Los Angeles Salary Range

$200,000 - $250,000 USD

The salary range represents base pay only and does not include short-term or long-term incentive compensation. This salary range is specific to New York City and may not be applicable to other locations. When determining base pay, as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

NYC Salary Range

Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About The Team

Fanatics Collectibles is building the future of trading cards and scaling fast. Our licenses span MLB, NBA, NFL, Premier League, UEFA, WWE, UFC, and more. To power this growth, we're modernizing Topps, one of the most storied brands in sports and entertainment collectibles. As trading cards evolve from a nearly 100-year-old analog craft into a technology-driven, global business, we are rebuilding the systems that power how cards are sold, priced, and distributed across a complex global commercial ecosystem.

We are hiring a Director of Product Management to own the commercial product portfolio that drives revenue growth, pricing intelligence, financial planning, and international expansion across Fanatics Collectibles. This is a senior people-leadership role with endto-end accountability for the product strategy and execution that powers how Topps goes to market.

What You'll Do



- Own the end-to-end product portfolio that powers commercial growth, including the internal enterprise systems that drive sales, pricing, customer intelligence, financial planning, and global market expansion.
- Set the product strategy for how Fanatics Collectibles grows B2B revenue, defends margin, and expands into priority international markets.
- Drive international expansion as a cross-functional product effort, going beyond feature localization to define the operating model, tooling, and partner integrations needed to make new geographies successful from launch through scale.
- Build and scale the Finance product portfolio that powers FP&A, planning cycles, and revenue projections, in deep partnership with the CFO organization.
- Develop a high-performing product team through hands-on coaching, clear performance standards, and deliberate investment in PMs' growth into senior operators.
- Lead communications and stakeholder management with senior leadership across the commercial organization.
- Apply AI and automation across the portfolio, identifying high-leverage opportunities to remove manual work, accelerate decision-making, and unlock new commercial capabilities (e.g., intelligent pricing, seller insights, predictive allocation).
- Operate as a senior leader within the Product organization, contributing to org-wide strategy, hiring, and culture, and representing the commercial portfolio at the executive level.

What We're Looking For



- 10 to 15 years of product management experience, including 3 to 5+ years in a senior product leadership role (Director or equivalent) with direct people management responsibility.
- Demonstrated success building and scaling enterprise sales, pricing, or finance-adjacent product portfolios, ideally in industries with complex go-to-market motions, multi-channel distribution, or global operations.
- Track record of leading international expansion work, including the operational, financial, and GTM complexity that comes with new market entry.
- Strong technical fluency and an ability to partner effectively with leaders across engineering, data science, and analytics.
- Executive presence and excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to clearly and confidently engage at the C-suite level.
- Experience leading through growth, ambiguity, and change, particularly in organizations undergoing digital transformation, platform modernization, or international expansion.
- Passion for trading cards and collectibles, or a demonstrated eagerness to become a world-class expert in this space. Deep curiosity and commitment to mastering this domain is essential.

Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don’t fall victim to fraud. Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including @collectfanatics.com). For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at www.fanaticsinc.com/careers

title: Founding Head of Product
descriptionHtml:
About Medley Learning

Medley Learning is building the AI that teachers and districts actually want in their classrooms – not generating lots of new, low-quality AI slop, but instead making it easier to implement established, strong pedagogy with high-quality content. We do this through a browser extension that wraps around all of a classroom’s existing digital content, adding reading and writing scaffolds customized to each student. We’ve begun by supporting multilingual learners, and will expand to serve students with disabilities next year. The result is that all learners can access the same instructional materials, and teachers save hours and hours of prep.


We are a mission-driven organization. In addition to building a thriving company, we are focused on enabling stronger student participation, reducing teacher burden, and achieving better outcomes in classrooms tasked with meeting increasingly diverse needs. Our approach is grounded in research-backed practices and is already being used by over 20 districts across the US.


Medley is led by CEO Brandon Cardet-Hernandez, a former multilingual learner who has worked across K-12 as a teacher, turnaround principal, policy advisor, and edtech leader. The company is backed by Workshop Ventures and advised by leading researchers.


The Opportunity

This is a special opportunity to join a young company with momentum and funding, but early enough to have a tremendous impact on the product direction, company strategy, and organizational culture. We are looking for a hands-on leader who is eager to dig into critical, detailed decisions and, at the same time, can serve as a thought partner to the CEO, helping build Medley into a leader in the AI edtech space. You will be one of the CEO’s closest partners in shaping Medley’s product vision, company direction, and long-term perspective on how AI should support learning in classrooms.


This is a true player/coach role. You will write specs, run research, define success metrics, make hard prioritization calls, and work closely with engineering to ship. Over time, you will build and lead the product team, but in the early days, you should be energized by doing the work yourself.


You are joining a team of six that will grow to ten by summer, with fresh pre-seed funding, strong district demand, and a plan to serve more than 15,000 multilingual learners this school year.


In the coming year, Medley will extend its work to serve students with disabilities. Together, multilingual learners and students with disabilities represent more than 20% of U.S. K-12 students, and both groups have been historically underserved by edtech.


We are approaching special education deliberately. This is not simply a matter of repackaging our multilingual learner product for a new segment. Special education involves diverse instructional needs, distinct purchasing dynamics, compliance requirements, and a high bar for trust with districts, educators, students, and families.


You will also help Medley stay ahead of the AI curve. That means tracking changes in model capabilities, safety practices, classroom use cases, district expectations, and the competitive landscape, then translating that signal into an ambitious and responsible roadmap.


What You'll Do

  • Own Product Vision and Roadmap: Define and prioritize the roadmap, balancing student outcomes, teacher needs, and district priorities while maintaining a high-quality bar.
  • Stay Close to the Classroom: Spend time with students, teachers, and district leaders to understand their needs and keep the product grounded in classroom reality.
  • Lead the Expansion into Special Education: Build and sequence the special education roadmap to strengthen Medley’s core multilingual learner product.
  • Ship with Engineering: Partner closely with Engineering to turn ideas into shipped features, building a delightful user experience and interface for both students and teachers.
  • Define Product Metrics and Operating Cadence: Establish key product metrics and operating rhythms that guide decisions and scale a strong product organization.
  • Build and Lead the Product Team: While the first year will be scrappy and hands-on, over time, you will build a product team that drives adoption, retention, and impact.


Required Qualifications

  • Student and Teacher Empathy. Classroom reality isn't abstract to you. You've designed for or worked closely with kids, teachers, or educators.
  • Product Craft. You have experience building and shipping products that users value. You can speak clearly about the tradeoffs you made and what you'd do differently now.
  • AI-Native Product Judgment. You use AI fluently in your own work and have strong judgment about where it belongs in high-trust classroom environments. You follow where AI capabilities are heading, but you care more about building useful, reliable, and responsible products than chasing novelty.
  • User Research Instincts. You know how to learn from teachers and students and turn what you hear into sharper roadmap choices.
  • Clarity of Thought. You make ambiguity easier to navigate. You can write crisp specs, explain tradeoffs, separate signal from noise, and help engineers, educators, executives, and district partners understand what matters and why.
  • Commercial Orientation. You understand that strong K-12 product decisions must account for adoption, implementation, renewals, procurement, and stakeholder trust.
  • Startup Orientation. You thrive in early-stage environments, embrace ambiguity, and stay hands-on even in senior roles.


Preferred Backgrounds

We are open to several paths, including:


  • Former teachers, school leaders, or education operators who transitioned into product and have developed strong product craft.
  • Product leaders from edtech companies who have shipped instructional, student-facing, accessibility, or classroom workflow products.
  • Product builders who have worked on AI-enabled products and understand how to balance speed, quality, safety, and trust.
  • Product leaders from consumer or consumer-like companies who have shipped products that kids, families, or non-technical users choose to use regularly.
  • Multilingual candidates, former multilingual learners, or candidates with deep personal or professional experience in multilingual communities are especially encouraged to apply.

title: Head of Product - Smart Buildings
descriptionHtml:
Head of Product – Smart Buildings Embassy 247 IT Park, Vikhroli, Mumbai | 15–20 years experience required


Mandatory Requirement

IoT or hardware experience essential. Applicants with SaaS-only backgrounds will not be considered. Freespace (afreespace.com) delivers workplace intelligence through IoT sensors, real time analytics, employee apps, signage, and space management—driving optimized designs, smart automations, and exceptional employee experiences.


Role Overview

Lead product vision, strategy, and execution for global IoT products in occupancy sensing, air quality, energy monitoring, and building management. Bridge customers, vendors, and teams to boost efficiency, sustainability, and occupant experience. Own customer growth, revenue, profitability; manage Product Owners, Analysts, and Solution Experts.


Key Responsibilities

• Define bold product vision/strategy and quarterly roadmaps aligned to growth goals, market trends, and client needs.

• Engage US/UK/global clients in meetings; capture feedback, analyze NPS, and refine offerings.

• Track KPIs (adoption, retention, quality); oversee lifecycle from ideation to scale, reviewing support tickets.

• Drive commercial success: pricing, monetization (subscriptions/licensing), margins via exec collaboration. • Partner with GTM/marketing/sales on positioning, launches, and global product market fit.

• Lead Agile processes: backlog grooming, sprint planning/reviews, trade-offs, fostering autonomous teams.

• Ensure compliance (BACnet/MQTT/Modbus, LEED/BREEAM), security, and vendor integrations for sensors/edge/cloud.

• Communicate roadmaps to stakeholders; champion research on competitors, trends, and customer behavior.


Required Experience & Skills

• 15–20 years in IoT/Smart Buildings (8+ in leadership); proven scaling of enterprise IoT solutions globally. • Commercial expertise: pricing, revenue growth, client negotiations.

• Deep IoT knowledge: sensors, embedded systems, protocols (Wi Fi/BLE/LoRaWAN), edge computing, HVAC/lighting integration.

• Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), data analytics, device-to-cloud comms, cybersecurity (encryption/firmware).

• Agile mastery: user stories, sprints, metrics (NPS/retention); strong analytics and stakeholder management.

• UI prototyping/wireframing; primary/secondary research; negotiation; team leadership. Must-Haves Nice-to-Haves IoT/hardware leadership Energy optimization strategies Global product scaling BMS integrations Agile + commercial ownership Sustainability certifications Ideal Candidate Visionary who thrives in ambiguity, with sharp logic, ideation skills, and cross-team relationship building. Why Freespace?

• Interact with global customers Freespace Confidential • Shape cutting-edge IoT for sustainable workplaces.

• Hybrid flexibility, growth-focused culture.

• Competitive salary/bonus, health benefits, paid leave, training.


Apply now: Send CV to hrindia@afreespace.com by 30th June 2026. We value diverse applicants.

title: VP/Head of Department – Product
descriptionHtml:
About Us

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

About Energy Systems

We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.

About The Role

About Platform Services

The energy transition has moved past the technology-proving phase. Today, the defining challenge is orchestrating millions of distributed energy assets reliably, securely, and at the pace the grid demands.

Platform Services is the digital growth engine for DNV Energy Systems North America, built on a fundamental conviction: the grid doesn't need more hardware. It needs better intelligence.

Our mission is to bridge infrastructure complexity with commercial execution by delivering secure, AI-native SaaS platforms that turn digital ambition into operational reality for Tier-1 utilities and energy operators.

Our vision is to unify the fragmented legacy architectures of utility program operations into a single, modern data model building the operational nervous system that accelerates the path to decarbonization. As we scale to support 4x customer-account growth over the next three years, this is one of the most consequential platform-engineering challenges in the energy sector.

About The Role

The VP/Head of Department-Product is the integrator at the heart of Platform Services. You own the integrated platform roadmap and customer experience across the eTRACK+ portfolio including AI-enabled features. You decide what Platform Services builds, in what sequence, packaged how, and priced how. You close the loop between customer signals from Commercial, AI capabilities from Enterprise AI, and engineering execution from Engineering .

This is a product leadership role with three center-of-gravity responsibilities: leading the platform-and-modules repositioning that converts a multi-product portfolio into a unified platform; launching the AI tier as the company's most defensible commercial differentiator; and translating the broader trends reshaping utility operations into scalable product strategy.

This role requires collaboration across multiple time zones, including both India and U.S. time zones.

This role is based at our DNV office in Houston, TX; Oakland, CA; Austin, TX; Dallas, TX; Medford, MA; New York, NY; Seattle, WA; Chalfont, PA; Des Moines, IA; Detroit, MI; Madison, WI; Phoenix, AZ; Portland, OR, presenting a dynamic hybrid schedule where employees will typically spend three (3) days per week working from either a DNV office or client location/site. Further details regarding role-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.

The position may also be considered at other DNV offices within the continental U.S.

What You'll Do

Strategic platform leadership

  • Own the integrated eTRACK+ roadmap including AI-enabled features. Decide what gets built, in what sequence, with what tier positioning.
  • Lead the platform-and-modules repositioning convert the current portfolio into one unified platform with capability modules customers can adopt over time.
  • Translate utility industry transformation trends DER proliferation, grid digitization, AI-driven program operations, decarbonization mandates, IRA-funded electrification into scalable product and market strategy for Tier-1 utility customers.
  • Align Platform Services' direction with Energy Systems' broader digital strategy and DNV's global priorities.
  • Leads and develops the department team by setting clear expectations, coaching for high performance, managing workloads, and fostering a positive, inclusive culture that supports growth and accountability.

Customer value, adoption, and the AI tier

  • Own platform packaging, pricing, and tier strategy across all modules including the AI tier as a packaging and pricing decision built on AI capabilities developed by Enterprise AI.
  • Develop the customer adoption and value model with structured feedback loops from customers, usage analytics, and domain experts.
  • Operate the Model C boundary with Enterprise AI: AI owns what's built; Product owns how it's packaged, priced, and integrated into the customer experience.
  • Equip Commercial, Customer Success, and Pre-Sales teams with enablement materials, training, and product narratives that drive consistent, confident deployment.

Commercialization and market positioning

  • Define commercial models pricing, licensing, packaging, partnership structures that support sustainable growth across the 2-3x revenue growth trajectory.
  • Partner with Commercial on go-to-market execution, anchor account expansion, and converting fast-growing accounts into multi-year platform commitments.
  • Drive analyst engagement on product narrative and category positioning.
  • Represent DNV's digital direction in strategic customer engagements, partnerships, and industry forums.

Product discipline and outcomes

  • Own the win-loss program across all deals structured customer interviews, quarterly synthesis, roadmap implications.
  • Run product analytics and the discipline that ties roadmap decisions to customer outcomes (NRR, attach rate, win rate).
  • Lead alignment of product-related innovation across Energy Systems to ensure cohesive digital strategy and shared innovation foundations.

KPI priorities

  • Deliver platform-and-modules repositioning, with refreshed pricing framework
  • Launch AI tier with published pricing packaging and pricing owned by Product, capabilities built by AI, sold by Commercial.
  • Deliver consolidated product roadmap across multiple solutions
  • Reach 25%+ AI tier attach rate on new deals
  • Win-loss program operational across all $500K+ deals; quarterly synthesis driving roadmap decisions.

What we offer

What We Offer

  • Generous paid time off (vacation, sick days, company holidays, personal days)
  • Multiple Medical and Dental benefit plans to choose from, Vision benefits
  • Spending accounts – FSA, Dependent Care, Commuter Benefits, company-seeded HSA
  • Employer-paid, therapist-led, virtual care services through Talkspace
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Company provided life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability benefits
  • Education reimbursement program
  • Flexible work schedule with hybrid opportunities
  • Charitable Matched Giving and Volunteer Rewards through our Impact Program
  • Volunteer time off (VTO) paid by the company
  • Career advancement opportunities
  • Benefits vary based on position, tenure, location, and employee election**

For California, Washington, New York, Washington, D.C., Illinois, and Maryland: DNV provides a reasonable range of compensation for this role. The actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. For the states of California, Washington, New York, Washington, D.C., Illinois, and Maryland only, the starting pay range for this role is $175,000- $250,000.

DNV is a proud equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, or business need, without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. DNV is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity, including providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with a disability. US applicants with a physical or mental disability who require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process may contact the North America Recruitment Department (hrrecruitment.northamerica@dnv.com). Information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

For more information

https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal

About You

What Is Required

  • Bachelor’s degree required, or an equivalent combination of education and 15+ years of progressive, relevant experience.
  • 10+ years of SaaS product leadership, with at least 4 years at VP Product or Head of Product level.
  • Has run a multi-disciplinary product organization (Product Management, UX, Product Analytics, Product Marketing) at scale knows how to lead these as four distinct disciplines.
  • Has personally owned a SaaS product roadmap at $20M+ ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) scale, with demonstrated outcomes on win rate, NRR (Net Revenue Retention).
  • Experience working with SaaS products in the utility, energy, or other regulated industries.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with global teams across multiple time zones.
  • Pricing and packaging discipline has launched at least one pricing tier or commercial repackaging at a prior SaaS role. Can explain the pricing decisions, not just describe them.
  • AI fluency sufficient to make good packaging and pricing decisions about AI-enabled features.
  • Has worked through a roadmap-versus-deal trade-off conversation with a Commercial leader knows how to balance long-term platform investment with short-term revenue pressure.
  • Strong customer-facing executive presence and influencing skills in matrixed, cross-functional, multi-geography organizations.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • We conduct pre-employment drug and background screening.

What Is Preferred

  • Has launched and priced an AI capability tier at a prior SaaS role.
  • Existing analyst relationships (Gartner, Forrester, GTM Research, Wood Mackenzie).
  • Win-loss program leadership has owned a structured win-loss interview program at a prior SaaS company.
  • Familiarity with utility transformation themes DER orchestration, grid digitization, IRA-funded electrification, regulated program operations.
  • Experience integrating advanced analytics or AI into digital products responsibly and at scale.
  • Immigration-related employment benefits, for example visa sponsorship, are not available for this position*

This is a product leadership role with three center-of-gravity responsibilities: leading the platform-and-modules repositioning that converts a multi-product portfolio into a unified platform; launching the AI tier as the company's most defensible commercial differentiator; and translating the broader trends reshaping utility operations into scalable product strategy.

This role requires collaboration across multiple time zones, including both India and U.S. time zones.

This role is based at our DNV office in Houston, TX; Oakland, CA; Austin, TX; Dallas, TX; Medford, MA; New York, NY; Seattle, WA; Chalfont, PA; Des Moines, IA; Detroit, MI; Madison, WI; Phoenix, AZ; Portland, OR, presenting a dynamic hybrid schedule where employees will typically spend three (3) days per week working from either a DNV office or client location/site. Further details regarding role-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.

The position may also be considered at other DNV offices within the continental U.S.

What You'll Do

Strategic platform leadership



- Own the integrated eTRACK+ roadmap including AI-enabled features. Decide what gets built, in what sequence, with what tier positioning.
- Lead the platform-and-modules repositioning convert the current portfolio into one unified platform with capability modules customers can adopt over time.
- Translate utility industry transformation trends DER proliferation, grid digitization, AI-driven program operations, decarbonization mandates, IRA-funded electrification into scalable product and market strategy for Tier-1 utility customers.
- Align Platform Services' direction with Energy Systems' broader digital strategy and DNV's global priorities.
- Leads and develops the department team by setting clear expectations, coaching for high performance, managing workloads, and fostering a positive, inclusive culture that supports growth and accountability.

Customer value, adoption, and the AI tier



- Own platform packaging, pricing, and tier strategy across all modules including the AI tier as a packaging and pricing decision built on AI capabilities developed by Enterprise AI.
- Develop the customer adoption and value model with structured feedback loops from customers, usage analytics, and domain experts.
- Operate the Model C boundary with Enterprise AI: AI owns what's built; Product owns how it's packaged, priced, and integrated into the customer experience.
- Equip Commercial, Customer Success, and Pre-Sales teams with enablement materials, training, and product narratives that drive consistent, confident deployment.

Commercialization and market positioning



- Define commercial models pricing, licensing, packaging, partnership structures that support sustainable growth across the 2-3x revenue growth trajectory.
- Partner with Commercial on go-to-market execution, anchor account expansion, and converting fast-growing accounts into multi-year platform commitments.
- Drive analyst engagement on product narrative and category positioning.
- Represent DNV's digital direction in strategic customer engagements, partnerships, and industry forums.

Product discipline and outcomes



- Own the win-loss program across all deals structured customer interviews, quarterly synthesis, roadmap implications.
- Run product analytics and the discipline that ties roadmap decisions to customer outcomes (NRR, attach rate, win rate).
- Lead alignment of product-related innovation across Energy Systems to ensure cohesive digital strategy and shared innovation foundations.

KPI priorities



- Deliver platform-and-modules repositioning, with refreshed pricing framework
- Launch AI tier with published pricing packaging and pricing owned by Product, capabilities built by AI, sold by Commercial.
- Deliver consolidated product roadmap across multiple solutions
- Reach 25%+ AI tier attach rate on new deals 
- Win-loss program operational across all $500K+ deals; quarterly synthesis driving roadmap decisions.

What we offer

What We Offer



- Generous paid time off (vacation, sick days, company holidays, personal days)
- Multiple Medical and Dental benefit plans to choose from, Vision benefits
- Spending accounts – FSA, Dependent Care, Commuter Benefits, company-seeded HSA
- Employer-paid, therapist-led, virtual care services through Talkspace
- 401(k) with company match
- Company provided life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability benefits
- Education reimbursement program
- Flexible work schedule with hybrid opportunities
- Charitable Matched Giving and Volunteer Rewards through our Impact Program
- Volunteer time off (VTO) paid by the company
- Career advancement opportunities 
- Benefits vary based on position, tenure, location, and employee election**

For California, Washington, New York, Washington, D.C., Illinois, and Maryland: DNV provides a reasonable range of compensation for this role. The actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. For the states of California, Washington, New York, Washington, D.C., Illinois, and Maryland only, the starting pay range for this role is $175,000- $250,000.

DNV is a proud equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, or business need, without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. DNV is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity, including providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with a disability. US applicants with a physical or mental disability who require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process may contact the North America Recruitment Department (hrrecruitment.northamerica@dnv.com). Information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

For more information

https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal

About You

What Is Required



- Bachelor’s degree required, or an equivalent combination of education and 15+ years of progressive, relevant experience.
- 10+ years of SaaS product leadership, with at least 4 years at VP Product or Head of Product level.
- Has run a multi-disciplinary product organization (Product Management, UX, Product Analytics, Product Marketing) at scale knows how to lead these as four distinct disciplines.
- Has personally owned a SaaS product roadmap at $20M+ ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) scale, with demonstrated outcomes on win rate, NRR (Net Revenue Retention).
- Experience working with SaaS products in the utility, energy, or other regulated industries.
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with global teams across multiple time zones.
- Pricing and packaging discipline has launched at least one pricing tier or commercial repackaging at a prior SaaS role. Can explain the pricing decisions, not just describe them.
- AI fluency sufficient to make good packaging and pricing decisions about AI-enabled features.
- Has worked through a roadmap-versus-deal trade-off conversation with a Commercial leader knows how to balance long-term platform investment with short-term revenue pressure.
- Strong customer-facing executive presence and influencing skills in matrixed, cross-functional, multi-geography organizations.
- Strong written and verbal English communication skills. 
- We conduct pre-employment drug and background screening.

What Is Preferred 



- Has launched and priced an AI capability tier at a prior SaaS role.
- Existing analyst relationships (Gartner, Forrester, GTM Research, Wood Mackenzie).
- Win-loss program leadership has owned a structured win-loss interview program at a prior SaaS company.
- Familiarity with utility transformation themes DER orchestration, grid digitization, IRA-funded electrification, regulated program operations.
- Experience integrating advanced analytics or AI into digital products responsibly and at scale.
- Immigration-related employment benefits, for example visa sponsorship, are not available for this position*

title: Head of AI (SaaS)
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

team.blue is an ecosystem of successful brands working together across regions to provide customers with everything they need to succeed online. 60+ successful brands make up the group; within those brands, 4.000 experts serve its 3.5 million customers across Europe and beyond.

team.blue's brands are a mix of traditional hosting businesses, offering services from domain names, email, shared hosting, e-commerce and server hosting solutions and specialist SaaS providers offering adjacent products such as compliance, marketing tools and team collaboration products. This broad product offering makes it a one-stop partner for online businesses and entrepreneurs across Europe.

Position Overview

As Head of SaaS AI, you will be responsible for enabling AI Product innovation of our SaaS brands, and aligning their AI initiatives and product roadmaps with the overall team.blue AI & Data strategy.

You will support the brands in creating and executing their AI & Data product roadmaps and initiatives, driving the use of AI & ML in their products and supporting AI & Data product development.

This role will act as the key liaison between the central group AI & Data function and the brands, driving collaboration, and enabling shared AI & Data value creation across the portfolio.

Key Responsibilities:

AI Product Innovation

  • Partner with brands to identify and develop innovative AI products, use cases and initiatives that create business value
  • Design AI solution architectures and flow patterns that align technical possibilities with business stakeholder needs
  • Shape the creation and execution of brand AI product roadmaps and drive AI product innovation to support brand growth priorities and group priorities


Technical Guidance & Support

  • Act as a sounding board for the brand product teams as they build AI products, advising and guiding them and sharing your knowledge of AI & Data advances
  • Support fast development of AI products and initiatives by coordinating access to the group AI & Data teams and resources
  • Aid in the due diligence process of prospective companies when appropriate, by vetting the feasibility and defensibility of their AI & ML-powered products
  • Champion AI upskilling initiatives to increase brand self-sufficiency over time


Strategic Alignment

  • Act as a liaison between the brands and the group AI & Data function, serving as the single point of contact regarding AI & Data topics
  • Coordinate AI initiatives and roadmaps between and across the brands and with the group AI & Data function
  • Ensure alignment of brand AI initiatives with the group AI & Data strategy and priorities while respecting brand autonomy and growth path


Communication & Governance

  • Enable communication flows between the brands and group AI & Data function, ensuring alignment on priorities and supporting rapid decision making
  • Ensure visibility into brand AI & Data activities, timelines, and risks with regular strategic briefings, presentations and updates for executive stakeholders
  • Ensure visibility of group AI & Data resources and initiatives within the brands


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience shipping AI products to real end users and driving AI product innovation, ideally within the SaaS space
  • Strong technical background in AI & Data and understanding of AI and Data's strategic business potential and how to translate it into product features and initiatives
  • Experience shaping and managing product or AI & Data roadmaps in close collaboration with technical, product and commercial teams
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with proven ability to manage and influence senior stakeholders in a matrixed environment
  • Skilled communicator, able to balance strategic alignment with local autonomy and business priorities
  • Comfortable operating at both strategic and technical levels, with the ability to zoom in and out seamlessly, and work across technical and business teams
  • Structured, analytical mindset with the ability to synthesize complex inputs into actionable direction
  • Experience in post-merger integration or multi-brand strategy environments is a plus


"Come as you are"

Everyone is welcome here. Diversity & Inclusion are at our core. Far above any technical competence, we value respect, openness, and trusted collaboration. We do not tolerate intolerance.

ESG

“At team.blue, our commitment to caring for the environment and each other is at the heart of everything we do. Our latest impact report showcases our ongoing ESG efforts and ambitious sustainability goals. Interested in learning more about our dedication to making a positive impact? Check it out here.”

The most trusted digital enabler

team.blue is a leading digital enabler for companies and entrepreneurs. It serves over 3.3 million customers in Europe and has more than 3,000 experts to support them. Its goal is to shape technology and to empower businesses with innovative digital services.

Click here to read more about team.blue

title: Director of Product
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Entain India is the engineering and delivery powerhouse for Entain, one of the world’s leading global sports and gaming groups. Established in Hyderabad in 2001, we’ve grown from a small tech hub into a dynamic force, delivering cutting-edge software solutions and support services that power billions of transactions for millions of users worldwide.

Our focus on quality at scale drives us to create innovative technology that supports Entain’s mission to lead the change in global sports and gaming sector. At Entain India, we make the impossible possible, together.


As Director of Product, you will be responsible for driving the vision, strategy, and execution of our product portfolio to deliver exceptional Core Platform & CRM products & services whilst achieving our business goals. You would develop and lead a world class team of product leaders across our locations and be responsible for your platform pillar experience within the Entain group for all our markets and all our brands.

In your role you are part of the Senior Product Leadership Team and will also be working with Entain’s Global Leadership, reporting to the CTO you will be part of the Platform Team.

Are you ready to launch a winning career?


What will you do:

  • You will develop and articulate a compelling and inspiring Core Platform and CRM product vision and strategy that delights our upstream services and customers. You will live and breathe the data and insights about your products, constantly seeking points of leverage that will help us achieve Entain’s broader goals and ambitions.
  • You will champion our transformation of the Platform by partnering with the Platform Engineering Director to modernise the Core Platform and CRM (reward) components which underpin all our businesses.
  • You will design a model for the core Player Account Management (PAM) services as a Platform-as-a-Service, enabling flexible integration and loose coupling.
  • You will use a techno-functional approach to design backend systems that support multiple micro frontend labels effectively.
  • You will develop, lead and coach a stellar team of product managers, guiding them in discovery, prioritization, and execution of product initiatives. By providing development, coaching, objectives and goal setting and performance management, you will ensure the team is motivated and productive, achieving real customer and business impact.
  • You will ensure that your product organisation is aligned with the broader company in pursuing the best opportunities, collaborating closely with cross-functional leaders including design, technology, compliance, commercial, finance and legal.
  • You will partner with technology and design teams to deliver a world class product offering, ensure quality, effective and timely product delivery. You will drive product metrics that demonstrate your product impact for our customers and our business. Aligning product direction and roadmap, you will be making trade-offs as necessary with key stakeholders across the business to deliver high-quality products at a predictable cadence.
  • You will serve as product evangelist both internally and externally. Present product updates and benefits to stakeholders, customers and partners


Qualifications:

  • Significant Product leadership experience managing and leading at a director level in a Product-Led organisation.
  • A demonstrated track record of successfully launching and iteratively scaling online products.
  • Strong understanding of the ecommerce landscape, including knowledge of regulations and compliance considerations when building great customer experiences.
  • Proven experience leading and developing high-performing empowered product teams.
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, analytical, and customer and business problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities, capable of collaborating with diverse teams and stakeholders.
  • Results-driven mindset with a focus on achieving business objectives while maintaining a player-centric approach.
  • Demonstrable evidence of influencing at senior levels of an organisation, the ability to get stakeholders and teams to buy-in into your product vision


Leadership responsibilities:

  • Set the vision and direction for the team, which aligns to our overall business strategy.
  • Provides effective and inspiring leadership and guidance to the teams, ensuring that they are working effectively and efficiently to achieve company goals.
  • Recruits, develops, and retains top talent, actively coaching people to develop and grow, creating development opportunities as they arise.
  • Build a high-performance team culture where outstanding performance is recognised, rewarded and celebrated.


Company Benefits

We know that signing top players requires a great starting package, and plenty of support to inspire peak performance. Join us, and a competitive salary is just the beginning.

Depending on your role and location, you can expect to receive benefits like:

  • Safe home pickup and home drop (Hyderabad Office Only)
  • Group Mediclaim policy
  • Group Critical Illness policy
  • Communication & Relocation allowance
  • Annual Health check

And outside of this, you’ll have the chance to turn recognition from leaders and colleagues into amazing prizes. Join a winning team of talented people and be a part of an inclusive and supporting community where everyone is celebrated for being themselves.

title: Senior Director of Product
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Director of Product based in United Kingdom.

This role is a senior product leadership position responsible for defining and driving the vision, strategy, and execution of a global Employer of Record platform. You will own the end-to-end product experience across the entire employment lifecycle, ensuring seamless workflows that enable companies to hire, onboard, manage, and pay international talent at scale. The role sits at the intersection of product strategy, regulatory complexity, and operational execution, requiring a strong systems-thinking mindset. You will lead multiple Product Managers and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Go-To-Market teams. The environment is highly cross-functional, fast-evolving, and deeply mission-driven, with a strong emphasis on clarity, scalability, and measurable outcomes. This is a high-impact leadership role shaping both product direction and organizational execution standards across a global platform.

Accountabilities

  • Own the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and performance for the Employer of Record platform, ensuring alignment with company objectives and measurable customer outcomes.
  • Lead and scale multiple Product Managers, setting high standards for product discovery, execution, and delivery quality.
  • Translate strategic priorities into clear roadmaps, success metrics, and scalable execution plans across multiple product domains.
  • Drive prioritization across competing initiatives including new features, regulatory requirements, technical debt, and platform improvements.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional product initiatives requiring alignment across Engineering, Design, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders to ensure the product supports broader business goals, including growth, efficiency, and margin improvement.
  • Use data, insights, and customer feedback to inform decision-making and continuously improve product outcomes.
  • Foster an AI-first, high-performance product culture focused on speed, scalability, and operational excellence.
  • Represent the product domain at executive level, clearly communicating strategy, trade-offs, risks, and impact.
  • Build and develop a high-performing, remote-first product organization and contribute to broader product best practices.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in Product Management, including at least 5+ years in leadership roles managing Product Managers.
  • Strong experience in HR tech, EoR, payroll, compliance, or complex B2B SaaS environments.
  • Proven ability to define and communicate product vision and strategy tied to business and customer outcomes.
  • Strong systems-thinking mindset with experience translating complex regulatory or operational requirements into scalable product solutions.
  • Demonstrated success leading multi-team product organizations in high-growth or scale-up environments.
  • Excellent leadership skills with a track record of hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing product talent.
  • Strong product discovery and problem-framing skills, with the ability to turn ambiguity into structured execution plans.
  • Highly data-driven with strong analytical skills and comfort making decisions based on metrics and insights.
  • Experience driving AI-enabled or automation-focused product initiatives is strongly valued.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at executive level.

Benefits

  • Competitive global salary benchmarked to senior product leadership roles
  • Fully remote work with flexible location across Spain and EMEA time zones
  • Generous paid time off (including extended annual leave allowances)
  • Flexible working culture with async-first collaboration practices
  • Comprehensive mental health and wellbeing support programs
  • Home office setup and monthly wellbeing allowance
  • Paid parental leave with strong job protection policies
  • Learning and development budget for continuous growth
  • Opportunity to work on a global, high-impact platform shaping the future of employment infrastructure
  • Inclusive, mission-driven culture focused on trust, autonomy, and impact

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

 Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Head of Innovation & Brand Foresight
descriptionHtml:
Contract: Fixed Term/Secondment - up to 12 months

Closing date: 23rd June 2026

Location: Nottingham/London (weekly presence in Nottingham office is required)

Recruitment Partner: samantha.bramhall@boots.co.uk

As Head of Innovation & Brand Foresight you will be accountable for creating and for delivering and incredible Global innovation pipeline from concept through to launch for one of our No7BC brands. You will be leading a consumer-obsessed Foresight & Innovation function that translates deep human insight, cultural shifts, scientific discovery and emerging beauty trends into world-class, commercially powerful product propositions and compelling brand stories. It’ an exciting time for our business as many of our brands continue to create breakthrough in the market, along with some revolution of some of our customer favourites.

Sitting at the intersection of culture, consumer insight and creativity, you will play a critical role in defining our innovation agenda, uncovering white space opportunities, and partnering cross-functionally to bring standout concepts to life. Alongside leading a high-performing team, you will set the strategic direction for ideation and ensure we are building a pipeline of ideas that are both inspiring and commercially impactful.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the Product Development function to identify future growth opportunities and emerging consumer needs.
  • Own the innovation masterplan, making critical choices that shape our future product offerings.
  • Translate scientific advancements into differentiated innovation opportunities that resonate with consumers.
  • Build and lead strategic partnerships across internal functions and external partners to ensure successful launches.
  • Inspire and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of curiosity and creativity.

What You’ll Need To Have (our Must-haves)

  • Minimum of 5 years' experience in leading innovation/product development functions at a senior level.
  • Proven ability to inspire breakthrough thinking and foster a culture of innovation.
  • Strong commercial acumen with a track record of assessing market opportunities.
  • Exceptional storytelling skills to connect consumer insights with brand narratives.
  • Experience in building strategic partnerships to unlock new capabilities.

It would be great if you also have

  • Experience working across multiple categories and international markets.
  • A strong network within the beauty industry and innovation ecosystems.

Rewards designed for you

  • Boots Retirement Savings Plan
  • Discretionary annual bonus
  • Generous employee discounts
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption leave pay and gift card for anyone expecting or adopting a child
  • Flexible benefits scheme including option to buy additional holiday, discounted gym membership, life assurance, activity passes and much more.
  • Access to free, 24/7 counselling and support through TELUS Health, our Employee Assistance Programme.

There's lots more in our benefits and discounts, MyBoosts - there to give you that little lift in your everyday. Find out more at boots.jobs/rewards. Exclusions may apply; eligible roles only. Please note that any salary estimates provided on third-party sites are not endorsed by No7 Beauty Company and may not be accurate.

Who We Are

Five iconic brands make up No7 Beauty Company: No7, Liz Earle, Soap & Glory, Botanics and Sleek MakeUP. We believe in creating the best in beauty for everyone, from skin science to sustainability. We're known for products that deliver results and do good along the way. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, creating an inclusive workplace where our colleagues are empowered to be themselves and where diversity, equity and inclusion are part of how we do things, every day.

What's Next

If this sounds like the role for you, we'd love to hear from you. If you apply, our team will be in touch to let you know the outcome of your application or to arrange next steps. Where a role is advertised as full-time, we are open to discussing part-time and job share options during the application process. If you require additional support as part of the application and interview process, we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments to help you to be at your best.
