title: Director, AI Digital Product Management, Augmented Beauty Tech Incubator, L'Oréal Research & Innovation
descriptionHtml:
Director, AI Digital Product Management, Augmented Beauty Tech Incubator, L'Oréal Research & Innovation - San Francisco, California

Hello, we’re L’Oréal, we're not just building brands; we're shaping how the world experiences beauty (and it takes a lot of cool jobs to do it).

Intrigued? Keep reading, this might be the opportunity you've been searching for.

Who We Are

Join us at L’Oréal, the world's #1 beauty company present in over 150 markets. For over a century, we have been transforming; fueled by data, tech, innovation, and science. Together, we tackle big challenges while making sure we stay committed to making the world a more inclusive and a better place for everyone & our planet.

At L’Oréal Research & Innovation we are pushing the boundaries of Science & Tech. We invest heavily in cutting-edge research, leveraging advanced technologies to understand skin, hair, and microbiome, while discovering new active ingredients and launching outperforming formulas. Our 3,500 L'Oréal R&I experts leverage Science & Technology to invent safe, trustable, sustainable & responsible beauty products and experiences that will change people’s lives.

Augmented Beauty Innovation is the startup-style upstream arm of L’Oréal R&I’s Beauty Tech organization. This team explores new technologies and ideas, then develops them in partnership with both external tech companies and internal beauty experts, turning them into functional prototypes with user-centric designs and experiences that can be launched as beauty products and services.

Within Augmented Beauty Innovation, the Global Digital team leverages expertise in AI, digital product development, data science, and consumer UX to explore, prototype, and launch new digital services. This team is based in the Augmented Beauty US Hub but has a global remit within the digital space, collaborating closely with the Global CDMO, IT, and engineering teams to build new digital tech powered by R&I and industry innovations.

The Director, Digital Product Management will lead AI and digital innovation efforts within this team, focusing on driving the success of specific products and ensuring they deliver measurable customer value and business results. This role encompasses the entire innovation lifecycle, blending strategic vision with tactical execution. They will identify, develop, and pilot groundbreaking digital products and services that leverage emerging technologies, with a focus on generative AI. Responsibilities will include concepting, exploring consumer needs, securing internal buy-in through pitches, building and leading cross-functional project teams, working within the L’Oreal Innovation process, and guiding projects through prototyping and handoff to development teams for implementation. They will input into the strategic roadmap that defines the future of digital beauty within the organization, ensuring innovations are both aspirational and achievable.

A Day in the Life: As a Director of Digital Product Management you will:

  • AI Services Innovation: be a thought leader in how AI-powered services integrate into and reinvent e-commerce platforms, digital infrastructure, professional tools, and in-store experiences. Lead the hands-on development of new digital products, including prompt engineering, behavior optimization, and rapid prototyping.
  • Product Execution: drive the product innovation lifecycle from conception to pilot launch, serving as the bridge between technical innovation, L’Oreal Research Scientists, and business objectives of the Groupe’s brands and divisions. Translate complex challenges into actionable development sprints.
  • User Value Proposition champion the strategic analysis, positioning, and product narratives to select product features that resonate deeply with our target users, ensuring successful market adoption.
  • Project Leadership: lead product requirements and definition; collaborate with cross-functional internal teams, including IT, operations, marketing, and portfolio management; and guide projects through the L’Oréal process.

We Are Looking For: You’re a great match for this role if you are an innovator, entrepreneur, integrator, and problem-solver with a research-minded approach, eager to contribute to our Beauty Tech portfolio

  • Education: A completed Bachelor's or Master’s in a scientific, technical or related field is required. Advanced degree preferred.
  • Experience: 8+ years of product management experience with a focus on digital innovation, including defining, launching, and optimizing digital products and features. Demonstrated success in end-to-end product ownership, from high-level strategy to detailed execution.
  • 3+ years of experience leading strategic development and execution of digital products from concept through prototyping, iteration, and handoff to development teams, with experience using lean startup and agile methodologies.
  • Strong expertise in all stages of the digital product lifecycle, including user research, prototyping, iterative development, and agile methodologies.
  • Applied AI experience launching AI/ML-driven products; proficiency in prompt design techniques, agentic workflows, context window management, and system evaluation.
  • Solid understanding of digital interface design and user experience principles, with the ability to translate consumer insights into engaging and intuitive digital product experiences.
  • Deep knowledge of how augmented reality, generative AI, big data, and other digital beauty applications integrate into broader digital ecosystems, including e-commerce platforms, IT backend systems, and digital infrastructure.
  • Proven ability to build, lead, and motivate cross-functional digital product teams, including designers, developers, data scientists, and QA, to deliver innovative solutions.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to articulate the vision, value, and strategy of digital beauty products to diverse audiences, from technical teams to marketing and sales stakeholders.
  • Experience managing day-to-day technical and design direction, launching successful app products in the market, and developing products with an understanding of cutting-edge digital innovation technologies
  • Experience with complex product/outbound customer work; knowledge of market, landscape, and customer/user requirements in
  • Strong ability to influence stakeholders and build consensus for product vision and strategy through effective communication, internal pitching, and collaboration.
  • The ability to be onsite, in the office 3 days a week as this is an essential function of the position (required)
  • Authorization to work in the United States on a full-time, permanent, ongoing basis is required. No immigration support/sponsorship offered for this role.

What’s In It For You

  • A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)
  • Real responsibility from day 1, there’s no sitting on the sidelines at L’Oréal
  • An environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated!
  • A place where you can contribute to something bigger! Many of our brands have societal /environmental causes to make concrete difference
  • Base Salary Range: $138,500 - $200,800 (The actual compensation will depend on a variety of job-related factors which may include geographic location, work experience, education, and skill level)
  • Competitive Benefits Package (Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, Pension Plan)
  • Hybrid Work Policy (Up to 2 Days per week work from home for eligible roles, subject to manager approval)
  • Flexible Time Off (Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Vacation Buy Program, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays & More!)
  • Access to Company Perks (VIP Access to L’Oréal’s Internal Shop for Discounted Products, Monthly Mobile Allowance)
  • Learning and Development Opportunities (Unlimited Access to E-learnings, Lunch & Learn Sessions, Mentorship Programs, & More!)
  • Employee Resource Groups (Think Tanks and Innovation Squads)
  • Access to Mental Health & Wellness Programs

Don’t meet every single requirement? At L'Oréal, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and innovative workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the qualifications listed in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways! You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride in a diverse environment. We’re committed to guaranteeing inclusive recruitment processes and advocating for hiring and promoting each candidate in an ethical and equitable way. The Group strictly prohibits discrimination against any applicant for employment because of the individual’s gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, visible and/or invisible disabilities, socio-economic and/or multicultural origins, health conditions, age, religion, or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Head of Product - Wadhwani AI
descriptionHtml:
About The Company

Wadhwani AI Global (WAIG) is a non-profit AI research and product organisation building AI for social impact across the Global South, outside India. We work with governments, multilateral institutions, foundations, and on-the-ground partners to deploy AI solutions in agriculture, health, and education at population scale. With deepening operations in Rwanda, Kenya, Ethiopia, and across the African continent, we are entering a new phase of growth — building product capability that matches the scale and ambition of our partnerships.

Requirements

Role Overview

The Head of Product will lead products across the organisation. This is a senior leadership role responsible for the AI products WAIG builds, deploys, and scales across health, education, agriculture, and other social impact verticals. This role owns the product function end-to-end and partners closely with leadership on strategy, delivery, and donor engagement.

Your Role

  • Product Strategy & Vision
  • Define the product vision, roadmap, and priorities across health, education, and agriculture verticals
  • Translate WAIG's mission and donor commitments into a coherent multi-year product strategy
  • Make build-vs-partner-vs-consume decisions for AI capabilities across the portfolio
  • Drive product positioning in donor conversations, government engagements, and partner discussions
  • Delivery & Execution
  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI products from concept through deployment and scale
  • Set and enforce product standards: discovery rigour, technical specs, evaluation criteria, deployment quality
  • Run a disciplined product lifecycle: hypothesis → MVP → field evaluation → iteration → scale
  • Ensure timely, high-quality delivery against grant commitments and donor milestones
  • Team Leadership
  • Build and lead the product organisation — recruit, mentor, and grow product talent across geographies
  • Foster a strong product culture: user-obsessed, evidence-driven, technically rigorous
  • Partner closely with the Technology team on engineering capacity, infrastructure, and ML delivery
  • External Engagement
  • Represent WAIG's product capability in conversations with governments (Ministry of ICT Rwanda, Smart Africa, ministries of health and education across Africa), multilateral institutions (UNICEF, UNDP, World Bank), and donors (Gates Foundation, others)
  • Lead product portions of major proposals and donor pitches; contribute to fundraising in partnership with the Growth lead
  • Build relationships with peer organisations, research labs, and AI-for-good ecosystems
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Partner with senior leadership on overall organisational strategy and delivery commitments
  • Work with the Growth and Fundraising lead on pipeline shaping and proposal development
  • Support the broader leadership team in operationalising the WAIG strategy

What We Are Looking For

Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in AI product management
  • Track record of building and shipping AI/ML products at scale — in real-world deployment
  • contexts, not pure consumer or pure research
  • Direct experience working with governments on technology deployments
  • Experience working with or in Africa, the Global South, or comparable contexts strongly preferred

Capability

  • Strong technical depth — able to engage credibly with ML engineers, evaluate technical trade-offs, and shape solution architecture
  • Outstanding strategic and structured thinking — able to set priorities, kill the wrong projects, and drive focus
  • Excellent communicator — equally comfortable in a Minister's office, a donor pitch, a field site, and a code review
  • Strong people leader — has built and grown product teams in distributed, multi-geography settings

Disposition

  • Mission-aligned — genuinely motivated by AI for social impact, not just by the title or the geography
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, frequent travel, and the realities of working in emerging-market deployment contexts
  • High ownership; low ego; bias to action

title: Sr. Manager of Research & Development
descriptionHtml:
Position Summary

The Sr. Manager of Research & Development is responsible for managing the Research & Development (R&D) teams to execute science-driven innovation and formulation strategies for food, chocolates, cosmetics, and nutritional supplement products. Helps develop and optimize products to meet consumer needs, regulatory requirements, and market differentiation. Continuously evaluates the product portfolio and suggests improvements based on experience, trends and customer feedback. Ensures all projects align with company strategy, timelines and technical standards.

Requirements

MINIMUM JOB QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Biochemistry, or Cosmetic Science or related field with 7+ years of industry-related experience; or a Master's degree with 5+ years of experience; or a PhD with 3+ years of relevant industry experience (PhD is preferred)
  • A minimum of 3 years of leadership experience managing R&D, formulation, or scientific teams within the nutraceutical, functional food, chocolates, and/or personal care industries is required
  • Strong track record of successfully leading and managing research and product development teams.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex scientific concepts for various audiences.
  • Experience with research evaluation, literature review, ingredient assessment, and claims substantiation to support innovative product development and commercialization
  • Demonstrated examples of dietary supplements, functional foods, and wellness-focused personal care products, with a strong understanding of formulation science, ingredient functionality, and regulatory requirements
  • Hands-on formulation and manufacturing experience with nutrition and protein bars, chocolate products, and functional snack applications utilizing food technology, and ingredients such as proteins, nuts, fibers, and natural sweeteners
  • Knowledge of product development processes for cosmetics and personal care products, including ingredient compatibility, stability, and consumer-driven innovation
  • Strong understanding of FDA, FTC, DSHEA, labeling regulations, and product claims compliance across dietary supplements, food products, and personal care categories
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Operations, Quality, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams to successfully scale products from concept through commercialization.
  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment and demonstrate the ability to organize and prioritize multiple competing tasks and demands

Other Essential Job Duties And Responsibilities

  • Lead R&D innovation and formulation initiatives across dietary supplements, functional foods, protein bars, chocolate products, and wellness-focused personal care products.
  • Evaluate ingredients, technologies, delivery systems, and dosage forms (capsules, powders, liquids, bars, and others) using scientific evidence to substantiate product efficacy and health claim substantiation
  • Manage product development team, and help guide projects from concept through commercialization, including formulation, prototyping, pilot production, scale-up, validation, and manufacturing transfer.
  • Integrate inventory-driven formulations to deplete excess inventories of discontinued formulas, blended powders and raw materials
  • Develop and formulate new meal replacement and nutrition bars, food products, and chocolates
  • Resolve any issues related to raw materials, formulations, and processes. Assist in pilot batches, scale-up activities, technical validation, and troubleshooting during manufacturing
  • Help guide raw material storage strategies in conjunction with Planning, Purchasing, and Inventory teams
  • Communicate and share emerging science and technologies, along with project status, risks, and recommendations, to senior leadership and the CEO.
  • Organizational skills in managing multiple projects, timelines, and stakeholder expectations
  • Implement R&D best practices, including PD lab operations, documentation standards, experimental design, and process optimization for scalable manufacturing
  • Set long-term R&D and innovation roadmap aligned with business growth and senior leadership
  • Cultivate external partnerships with suppliers, research institutions, and associations.
  • Critically evaluate published clinical research, technical reports, and related literature
  • Monitor market trends, competitor products, and emerging science
  • Understand label copy and promotional material workflows, ensuring proper review and approvals are completed
  • Represent the company at trade shows and meet with external clients/vendors, as needed
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities, as assigned

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Duties are performed primarily in a smoke-free laboratory and office environment
  • We pride ourselves on maintaining a clean and organized environment, fostering a sense of pride and ownership in our space
  • Our culture is rich in diversity, quality, safety, fun, and respect, creating a vibrant and inclusive atmosphere
  • We are dedicated to professionalism and growth, continually striving to improve and excel in all we do

Physical Requirements

  • Frequent sitting
  • Able to lift up to 25 lbs

Benefits

ProCaps provides :

  • A competitive salary!
  • Top-Tier Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage - $0 when you qualify for the Wellness Program!
  • Paid Time Off, Eight (8) Company Holidays
  • 401(k) with Company Match - up to 4.5%
  • 100% Company Life Coverage
  • 100% Short Term Disability Coverage
  • Gym Membership Reimbursement
  • Vitamin Allowance + Discounts
  • Company-Funded Health Savings Account ($1,600/year)
  • Cash Reward Employee Referral Program
  • Pet Insurance
  • Fantastic work environment that focuses on Safety, Quality, Community, and amazing people. We hire top talent and celebrate the ingenuity and tenacity of our team members and leaders!

title: Director, AI & Data Strategy - Technical Product Management for Responsible AI - Commercialization
descriptionHtml:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, AI & Data Strategy - Technical Product Management for Responsible AI - Commercialization

As a Director level Technical Product Manager for Responsible AI within the AI Governance team, you will lead the transformation of internal Responsible AI capabilities into customer-ready products and consulting offerings. Your mandate is to productionize Responsible AI tooling so it is scalable, supportable, robust, and packaged into an offering for global enterprise firms in highly regulated industries.

You will own the technical product direction for Responsible AI platforms while also providing solution architecture leadership to ensure Responsible AI expectations translate into deployable, auditable, and commercially viable solutions. This role operates at the intersection of engineering, governance, and go to market execution.

You will partner closely with internal AI, platform, legal, compliance, and consulting teams and possibly externally with customers, regulators, and ecosystem partners to shape repeatable Responsible AI products and services that can be delivered consistently across jurisdictions and infrastructure environments.

Role Overview

This role combines technical product management, solution architecture, and commercialization leadership for Responsible AI capabilities.

As the Technical Product Owner

You are accountable for converting internal Responsible AI tooling into adoption ready and market facing offerings. This includes defining product boundaries, maturity standards, documentation, service offerings and ongoing success required for client deployment . You balance governance rigor with usability, scalability, and delivery feasibility.

As the Solution Shaping Architect

You work early with customers, regulators, and delivery teams to define end to end Responsible AI solutions that operate within real world constraints such as cloud, on premises, sovereign, and hybrid environments and that align with regulatory, contractual, and operational expectations.

You lead through influence by aligning engineering, governance, legal, compliance, and delivery teams to make decisions under ambiguity and ensure Responsible AI products can be sold, deployed, operated, and maintained at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Product Management Responsible AI Commercialization

Collaborate with internal teams to define the productization strategy for Responsible AI tooling, evolving internal platforms and prototypes into sellable products or consulting accelerators.

Define and manage technical product requirements including epics, acceptance criteria, and dependencies with an explicit focus on external usability, operability, and governance defensibility.

Establish product standards for commercial readiness including documentation, audit evidence, configuration guidance, versioning, and support and operating models.

Translate complex data science and Responsible AI concepts into clear client ready value propositions and provide precise direction to engineering teams.

Track outcomes and adoption signals to identify when Responsible AI tools or services require refinement, modularization, repositioning, or retirement.

Solution Architecture Deployable and Client Ready Responsible AI

Engage directly with customers, government agencies, regulators, and partners to understand deployment environments, security models, regulatory requirements, and operational constraints.

Design end to end Responsible AI by design systems that integrate data pipelines, models or large language models, orchestration layers, APIs, monitoring, human oversight, and documentation.

Translate governance and regulatory expectations into implementable system designs with clear operational controls, accountability, and evidence generation.

Define and promote reusable reference architectures, architectural patterns, and delivery playbooks that support repeatable client implementations.

Partner with privacy, security, and governance teams to ensure solutions are approval-ready and defensible during regulatory scrutiny, audits, and client due diligence.

Provide architectural guidance, design intent, and decision rationale to delivery teams responsible for implementation and client rollout.

Go to Market Enablement and Stakeholder Leadership

Partner with commercial, consulting, and delivery teams to ensure Responsible AI offerings are clearly scoped, repeatable, and scalable.

Advise stakeholders on trade offs across risk, scalability, explainability, delivery effort, and long term operational burden in client environments.

Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders by bridging policy intent, technical feasibility, and commercial execution.

Drive alignment across engineering, governance, legal, compliance, and operations teams and resolve conflicts to enable execution without formal authority.

All About You

Must Have

A strong academic background in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or equivalent practical experience.

Hands on experience building, testing, approving, and deploying data science or AI systems including post deployment lifecycle management.

Demonstrated success delivering production grade AI platforms or tooling intended for external use.

Experience working directly with external stakeholders such as customers, government agencies, regulators, vendors, or systems integrators.

Proven ability to operate in ambiguous environments, drive decisions through influence, and communicate clearly with both technical and non technical audiences.

Technical Skills

Experience building or scaling Responsible AI or AI governance tooling for external use.

Experience designing or integrating governance capabilities including monitoring, documentation, approval workflows, and lifecycle controls.

An understanding of the responsible AI marketplace and key products within the domain

Long term work eligibility for Singapore.

Preferred

Understanding of Python, SQL, and modern machine learning platforms such as Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, or SageMaker.

Familiarity with machine learning frameworks, data pipelines, model evaluation practices, and software architecture principles.

Experience contributing to centers of excellence, platform teams, or internal capability building initiatives that support multiple business units or clients.

Success Measures

Internal Responsible AI tools successfully transformed into adoption ready and client deployable products or consulting accelerators.

Clear product roadmaps and maturity models that support repeatable delivery at scale.

Successful deployment of Responsible AI solutions across diverse customer infrastructure environments.

Reuse of Responsible AI reference architectures, architectural patterns, and delivery playbooks across engagements and regions.

Increased confidence in the organization’s ability to operationalize Responsible AI commercially.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: VP/Head of Department – Product
descriptionHtml:
About Us

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

About Energy Systems

We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.

About The Role

About Platform Services

The energy transition has moved past the technology-proving phase. Today, the defining challenge is orchestrating millions of distributed energy assets reliably, securely, and at the pace the grid demands.

Platform Services is the digital growth engine for DNV Energy Systems North America, built on a fundamental conviction: the grid doesn't need more hardware. It needs better intelligence.

Our mission is to bridge infrastructure complexity with commercial execution by delivering secure, AI-native SaaS platforms that turn digital ambition into operational reality for Tier-1 utilities and energy operators.

Our vision is to unify the fragmented legacy architectures of utility program operations into a single, modern data model building the operational nervous system that accelerates the path to decarbonization. As we scale to support 4x customer-account growth over the next three years, this is one of the most consequential platform-engineering challenges in the energy sector.

About The Role

The VP/Head of Department-Product is the integrator at the heart of Platform Services. You own the integrated platform roadmap and customer experience across the eTRACK+ portfolio including AI-enabled features. You decide what Platform Services builds, in what sequence, packaged how, and priced how. You close the loop between customer signals from Commercial, AI capabilities from Enterprise AI, and engineering execution from Engineering .

This is a product leadership role with three center-of-gravity responsibilities: leading the platform-and-modules repositioning that converts a multi-product portfolio into a unified platform; launching the AI tier as the company's most defensible commercial differentiator; and translating the broader trends reshaping utility operations into scalable product strategy.

This role requires collaboration across multiple time zones, including both India and U.S. time zones.

This role is based at our DNV office in Houston, TX; Oakland, CA; Austin, TX; Dallas, TX; Medford, MA; New York, NY; Seattle, WA; Chalfont, PA; Des Moines, IA; Detroit, MI; Madison, WI; Phoenix, AZ; Portland, OR, presenting a dynamic hybrid schedule where employees will typically spend three (3) days per week working from either a DNV office or client location/site. Further details regarding role-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.

The position may also be considered at other DNV offices within the continental U.S.

What You'll Do

Strategic platform leadership

  • Own the integrated eTRACK+ roadmap including AI-enabled features. Decide what gets built, in what sequence, with what tier positioning.
  • Lead the platform-and-modules repositioning convert the current portfolio into one unified platform with capability modules customers can adopt over time.
  • Translate utility industry transformation trends DER proliferation, grid digitization, AI-driven program operations, decarbonization mandates, IRA-funded electrification into scalable product and market strategy for Tier-1 utility customers.
  • Align Platform Services' direction with Energy Systems' broader digital strategy and DNV's global priorities.
  • Leads and develops the department team by setting clear expectations, coaching for high performance, managing workloads, and fostering a positive, inclusive culture that supports growth and accountability.

Customer value, adoption, and the AI tier

  • Own platform packaging, pricing, and tier strategy across all modules including the AI tier as a packaging and pricing decision built on AI capabilities developed by Enterprise AI.
  • Develop the customer adoption and value model with structured feedback loops from customers, usage analytics, and domain experts.
  • Operate the Model C boundary with Enterprise AI: AI owns what's built; Product owns how it's packaged, priced, and integrated into the customer experience.
  • Equip Commercial, Customer Success, and Pre-Sales teams with enablement materials, training, and product narratives that drive consistent, confident deployment.

Commercialization and market positioning

  • Define commercial models pricing, licensing, packaging, partnership structures that support sustainable growth across the 2-3x revenue growth trajectory.
  • Partner with Commercial on go-to-market execution, anchor account expansion, and converting fast-growing accounts into multi-year platform commitments.
  • Drive analyst engagement on product narrative and category positioning.
  • Represent DNV's digital direction in strategic customer engagements, partnerships, and industry forums.

Product discipline and outcomes

  • Own the win-loss program across all deals structured customer interviews, quarterly synthesis, roadmap implications.
  • Run product analytics and the discipline that ties roadmap decisions to customer outcomes (NRR, attach rate, win rate).
  • Lead alignment of product-related innovation across Energy Systems to ensure cohesive digital strategy and shared innovation foundations.

KPI priorities

  • Deliver platform-and-modules repositioning, with refreshed pricing framework
  • Launch AI tier with published pricing packaging and pricing owned by Product, capabilities built by AI, sold by Commercial.
  • Deliver consolidated product roadmap across multiple solutions
  • Reach 25%+ AI tier attach rate on new deals
  • Win-loss program operational across all $500K+ deals; quarterly synthesis driving roadmap decisions.

What we offer

What We Offer

  • Generous paid time off (vacation, sick days, company holidays, personal days)
  • Multiple Medical and Dental benefit plans to choose from, Vision benefits
  • Spending accounts – FSA, Dependent Care, Commuter Benefits, company-seeded HSA
  • Employer-paid, therapist-led, virtual care services through Talkspace
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Company provided life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability benefits
  • Education reimbursement program
  • Flexible work schedule with hybrid opportunities
  • Charitable Matched Giving and Volunteer Rewards through our Impact Program
  • Volunteer time off (VTO) paid by the company
  • Career advancement opportunities
  • Benefits vary based on position, tenure, location, and employee election**

For California, Washington, New York, Washington, D.C., Illinois, and Maryland: DNV provides a reasonable range of compensation for this role. The actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. For the states of California, Washington, New York, Washington, D.C., Illinois, and Maryland only, the starting pay range for this role is $175,000- $250,000.

DNV is a proud equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, or business need, without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. DNV is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity, including providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with a disability. US applicants with a physical or mental disability who require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process may contact the North America Recruitment Department (hrrecruitment.northamerica@dnv.com). Information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

For more information

https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal

About You

What Is Required

  • Bachelor’s degree required, or an equivalent combination of education and 15+ years of progressive, relevant experience.
  • 10+ years of SaaS product leadership, with at least 4 years at VP Product or Head of Product level.
  • Has run a multi-disciplinary product organization (Product Management, UX, Product Analytics, Product Marketing) at scale knows how to lead these as four distinct disciplines.
  • Has personally owned a SaaS product roadmap at $20M+ ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) scale, with demonstrated outcomes on win rate, NRR (Net Revenue Retention).
  • Experience working with SaaS products in the utility, energy, or other regulated industries.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with global teams across multiple time zones.
  • Pricing and packaging discipline has launched at least one pricing tier or commercial repackaging at a prior SaaS role. Can explain the pricing decisions, not just describe them.
  • AI fluency sufficient to make good packaging and pricing decisions about AI-enabled features.
  • Has worked through a roadmap-versus-deal trade-off conversation with a Commercial leader knows how to balance long-term platform investment with short-term revenue pressure.
  • Strong customer-facing executive presence and influencing skills in matrixed, cross-functional, multi-geography organizations.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • We conduct pre-employment drug and background screening.

What Is Preferred

  • Has launched and priced an AI capability tier at a prior SaaS role.
  • Existing analyst relationships (Gartner, Forrester, GTM Research, Wood Mackenzie).
  • Win-loss program leadership has owned a structured win-loss interview program at a prior SaaS company.
  • Familiarity with utility transformation themes DER orchestration, grid digitization, IRA-funded electrification, regulated program operations.
  • Experience integrating advanced analytics or AI into digital products responsibly and at scale.
  • Immigration-related employment benefits, for example visa sponsorship, are not available for this position*

As we scale to support 4x customer-account growth over the next three years, this is one of the most consequential platform-engineering challenges in the energy sector.

About The Role

The VP/Head of Department-Product is the integrator at the heart of Platform Services. You own the integrated platform roadmap and customer experience across the eTRACK+ portfolio including AI-enabled features. You decide what Platform Services builds, in what sequence, packaged how, and priced how. You close the loop between customer signals from Commercial, AI capabilities from Enterprise AI, and engineering execution from Engineering .

This is a product leadership role with three center-of-gravity responsibilities: leading the platform-and-modules repositioning that converts a multi-product portfolio into a unified platform; launching the AI tier as the company's most defensible commercial differentiator; and translating the broader trends reshaping utility operations into scalable product strategy.

This role requires collaboration across multiple time zones, including both India and U.S. time zones.

This role is based at our DNV office in Houston, TX; Oakland, CA; Austin, TX; Dallas, TX; Medford, MA; New York, NY; Seattle, WA; Chalfont, PA; Des Moines, IA; Detroit, MI; Madison, WI; Phoenix, AZ; Portland, OR, presenting a dynamic hybrid schedule where employees will typically spend three (3) days per week working from either a DNV office or client location/site. Further details regarding role-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.

The position may also be considered at other DNV offices within the continental U.S.

What You'll Do

Strategic platform leadership



- Own the integrated eTRACK+ roadmap including AI-enabled features. Decide what gets built, in what sequence, with what tier positioning.
- Lead the platform-and-modules repositioning convert the current portfolio into one unified platform with capability modules customers can adopt over time.
- Translate utility industry transformation trends DER proliferation, grid digitization, AI-driven program operations, decarbonization mandates, IRA-funded electrification into scalable product and market strategy for Tier-1 utility customers.
- Align Platform Services' direction with Energy Systems' broader digital strategy and DNV's global priorities.
- Leads and develops the department team by setting clear expectations, coaching for high performance, managing workloads, and fostering a positive, inclusive culture that supports growth and accountability.

Customer value, adoption, and the AI tier



- Own platform packaging, pricing, and tier strategy across all modules including the AI tier as a packaging and pricing decision built on AI capabilities developed by Enterprise AI.
- Develop the customer adoption and value model with structured feedback loops from customers, usage analytics, and domain experts.
- Operate the Model C boundary with Enterprise AI: AI owns what's built; Product owns how it's packaged, priced, and integrated into the customer experience.
- Equip Commercial, Customer Success, and Pre-Sales teams with enablement materials, training, and product narratives that drive consistent, confident deployment.

Commercialization and market positioning



- Define commercial models pricing, licensing, packaging, partnership structures that support sustainable growth across the 2-3x revenue growth trajectory.
- Partner with Commercial on go-to-market execution, anchor account expansion, and converting fast-growing accounts into multi-year platform commitments.
- Drive analyst engagement on product narrative and category positioning.
- Represent DNV's digital direction in strategic customer engagements, partnerships, and industry forums.

Product discipline and outcomes



- Own the win-loss program across all deals structured customer interviews, quarterly synthesis, roadmap implications.
- Run product analytics and the discipline that ties roadmap decisions to customer outcomes (NRR, attach rate, win rate).
- Lead alignment of product-related innovation across Energy Systems to ensure cohesive digital strategy and shared innovation foundations.

KPI priorities



- Deliver platform-and-modules repositioning, with refreshed pricing framework
- Launch AI tier with published pricing packaging and pricing owned by Product, capabilities built by AI, sold by Commercial.
- Deliver consolidated product roadmap across multiple solutions
- Reach 25%+ AI tier attach rate on new deals 
- Win-loss program operational across all $500K+ deals; quarterly synthesis driving roadmap decisions.

What we offer

What We Offer



- Generous paid time off (vacation, sick days, company holidays, personal days)
- Multiple Medical and Dental benefit plans to choose from, Vision benefits
- Spending accounts – FSA, Dependent Care, Commuter Benefits, company-seeded HSA
- Employer-paid, therapist-led, virtual care services through Talkspace
- 401(k) with company match
- Company provided life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability benefits
- Education reimbursement program
- Flexible work schedule with hybrid opportunities
- Charitable Matched Giving and Volunteer Rewards through our Impact Program
- Volunteer time off (VTO) paid by the company
- Career advancement opportunities 
- Benefits vary based on position, tenure, location, and employee election**

For California, Washington, New York, Washington, D.C., Illinois, and Maryland: DNV provides a reasonable range of compensation for this role. The actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. For the states of California, Washington, New York, Washington, D.C., Illinois, and Maryland only, the starting pay range for this role is $175,000- $250,000.

DNV is a proud equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, or business need, without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. DNV is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity, including providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with a disability. US applicants with a physical or mental disability who require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process may contact the North America Recruitment Department (hrrecruitment.northamerica@dnv.com). Information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

For more information

https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal

About You

What Is Required



- Bachelor’s degree required, or an equivalent combination of education and 15+ years of progressive, relevant experience.
- 10+ years of SaaS product leadership, with at least 4 years at VP Product or Head of Product level.
- Has run a multi-disciplinary product organization (Product Management, UX, Product Analytics, Product Marketing) at scale knows how to lead these as four distinct disciplines.
- Has personally owned a SaaS product roadmap at $20M+ ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) scale, with demonstrated outcomes on win rate, NRR (Net Revenue Retention).
- Experience working with SaaS products in the utility, energy, or other regulated industries.
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with global teams across multiple time zones.
- Pricing and packaging discipline has launched at least one pricing tier or commercial repackaging at a prior SaaS role. Can explain the pricing decisions, not just describe them.
- AI fluency sufficient to make good packaging and pricing decisions about AI-enabled features.
- Has worked through a roadmap-versus-deal trade-off conversation with a Commercial leader knows how to balance long-term platform investment with short-term revenue pressure.
- Strong customer-facing executive presence and influencing skills in matrixed, cross-functional, multi-geography organizations.
- Strong written and verbal English communication skills. 
- We conduct pre-employment drug and background screening.

What Is Preferred 



- Has launched and priced an AI capability tier at a prior SaaS role.
- Existing analyst relationships (Gartner, Forrester, GTM Research, Wood Mackenzie).
- Win-loss program leadership has owned a structured win-loss interview program at a prior SaaS company.
- Familiarity with utility transformation themes DER orchestration, grid digitization, IRA-funded electrification, regulated program operations.
- Experience integrating advanced analytics or AI into digital products responsibly and at scale.
- Immigration-related employment benefits, for example visa sponsorship, are not available for this position*

title: Senior Director, Product Line Management - Dual Gender Hybrid Sneakers & Sport Footwear
descriptionHtml:
Mission/Role

The Senior Director, Product Line Management - Hybrid Sneakers & Sport Footwear will serve as the enterprise leader and in house expert for Cole Haan’s sneaker and sport footwear businesses, spanning lifestyle sneakers and performance categories including golf and running.

This role sits at the intersection of sport, performance, and fashion, drawing inspiration from both the world of athletic innovation and the broader fashion, style, and cultural landscape to create products that are technically credible, commercially compelling, and brand right.

Partnering closely with Product Management leadership and cross functional teams, this role is accountable for defining product line strategies and leading execution plans that deliver against financial, brand, and consumer objectives across global markets.

Operating with a general manager mindset, this leader will oversee the full product lifecycle from consumer insight and line architecture through margin delivery and go to market execution while working across Design, Product Development, Merchandising, Sales, and Marketing to translate strategy into commercial results.

Core Accountabilities

Category & Business Leadership

  • Act as the business leader for sneaker and sport footwear categories, contributing to revenue growth, gross margin and line productivity.
  • Define long‑range category strategies and seasonal product roadmaps aligned with brand vision, consumer demand, sport performance needs, and fashion‑driven trends.
  • Develop clear product, assortment, and commercialization plans to achieve established financial and commercial targets.

Product Line Strategy & Management

  • Lead end‑to‑end Product Line Management across men’s and women’s assortments, ensuring cohesive line architecture with clear differentiation by gender, usage occasion, performance need, style expression, and price tier.
  • Translate consumer insights, cultural and fashion trends, sport influence, and competitive intelligence into clear product strategies and actionable briefs.
  • Balance innovation, core continuity, and commercial franchises to support sustainable, long‑term category health.

Cross‑Functional Enterprise Leadership

  • Serve as the primary integrator across Design, Product Development, Merchandising, Sales, and Marketing to ensure alignment from concept through commercialization.
  • Partner closely with Design to shape category vision, design direction, and storytelling that reflects both sport authenticity and fashion relevance.
  • Collaborate with Development and Operations partners to support feasibility, timing, and margin delivery through the product lifecycle.

Go‑to‑Market & Commercialization

  • Lead seasonal line reviews, milestone gates, and go‑to‑market planning to ensure product readiness, differentiation, and clarity at launch.
  • Partner with Channel and Marketing teams to support channel strategies, key account priorities, and regional market needs.
  • Ensure compelling product narratives, pricing strategies, and value propositions across channels and markets.

Team & Organizational Leadership

  • Build, lead, and develop a high‑performing Product Line Management team.
  • Establish clear ways of working, decision frameworks, and performance standards.
  • Mentor and develop talent with a focus on strategic thinking, consumer mindset, and commercial acumen.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of progressive experience in footwear with significant leadership experience in Product Line Management, Category Management, or general‑management‑style roles.
  • Deep expertise in sneakers and performance footwear with a strong appreciation for fashion, design, and cultural influence.
  • Proven experience building and executing category strategies that deliver against revenue, margin, and growth objectives
  • Demonstrated success leading dual‑gender assortments across multiple price points, channels, and global markets.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strong commercial orientation with the ability to translate strategy into executable plans.
  • Strategic thinker with a balance of analytical rigor and creative sensibility.
  • Highly effective cross‑functional leader with strong influence and stakeholder management skills.
  • Data‑driven decision‑maker with comfort using insights to inform assortment, pricing, and investment decisions.
  • Clear, confident communicator with executive presence.

This position is not available to be performed in Colorado.

title: Head of Product
descriptionHtml:
Description

With AI reshaping every layer of the software stack, we have an opportunity to reimagine consumer software experiences — making them smarter, more personal, and more useful every day.

We are looking for a Head of Product to lead product strategy and execution for an existing consumer software platform within Amazon Devices & Services with millions of customers. You will own the think big product vision and customer experience across multiple Amazon device surfaces on a cross-functional product, working at the intersection of consumer product strategy, platform engineering, external partnerships, and AI/ML.

This role operates in a complex multi-stakeholder environment where multiple VP-level organizations depend on the products you own. You will drive alignment through data, written narratives, and high-judgment trade-offs — balancing near-term customer and business needs with long-term strategic positioning. The role includes think big proposal delivery and presentation to (S)VP audiences as we seek to reinvent customer experiences and create new initiatives.

If you're passionate about building products that reach massive scale, navigating ambiguity across senior leadership, and defining how AI transforms consumer software experiences, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a product and design team to define product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for consumer software platforms across Amazon's device portfolio
  • Foster an organizational culture that thinks big and takes risks, is customer obsessed, data driven, and communicates with clarity
  • Write PRFAQs that will be reviewed at the VP/SVP level
  • Drive cross-functional execution with engineering, science, business development, and executive teams
  • Own business outcomes including customer engagement, monetization, and partner alignment
  • Make high-judgment trade-offs between features, platform stability, and time-to-market

About The Team

This is a multi-site organization spanning Seattle, Sunnyvale, and Bangalore with engineering, product, design, science, and QA disciplines. We build software that is a critical dependency for Amazon's device programs — our work directly impacts device launches, OS releases, and the daily experience of tens of millions of customers.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of team management experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • 7+ years of end to end product delivery experience
  • Experience with AI/ML technologies

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering consumer software products and services in a high growth environment
  • Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale
  • Experience managing competing priorities across a wide range of stakeholders
  • Experience presenting to SVP and C-Level
  • Experience managing revenue-generating products with external partnership dependencies

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

title: Head of Engineering & Product
descriptionHtml:
Linkedin: www.linkedin.com/company/mindfriend/

Website: mindfriend.com/

MindFriend

  • Remote (UK/EU hours)
  • Full-time


We're looking for our senior engineering and product leader who will take MindFriend safely to launch and build the platform, and the team, that come after.

MindFriend is a mental-health marketplace connecting people with verified, licensed clinicians for online therapy: search, booking, payments, and live video, audio and chat sessions in one place. The platform is built and largely working, with a capable lead developer and a team. We're now bringing in the senior leader who will set the engineering bar, decide when we're ready to launch, and grow both the platform and the team from there with a level of ownership only the earliest team members ever get.

This role carries more weight than most engineering jobs. We handle sensitive health data and host live therapy sessions, so reliability and security aren't features they are the trust the entire category depends on. The person who gets this right will have real authority to do it properly, and will help shape what MindFriend becomes.

A word of honesty

This is a founding-team role at an early-stage company, which means it is hands-on. You will get into the code. You will run the QA passes yourself. You will test a video session on a bad connection at 9pm because a launch depends on it. You will make calls with incomplete information and live with them. You'll lead a small team and a freelance bench but you'll lead by doing, not just directing. If you want a purely strategic seat with people beneath you to execute, this is the wrong role. If you want to own the hardest, most consequential technical problems in the company and see them through, read on.

Requirements

What you'll be responsible for

  • The launch decision setting the readiness bar, and holding launch until it's met
  • Reliability of live video, audio and chat sessions on a user's old laptop and a clinician's poor wifi, not just a developer's machine
  • Security and privacy of sensitive health data the controls that keep us defensible, and an independent security review before we go live
  • End-to-end quality of the booking-and-payments flow, including the failure paths most teams skip
  • The product direction after launch what we build next, in what order, and why
  • Leading and growing the engineering and product team

What Success Looks Like

In your first weeks — to launch:

  • Own and close out the launch readiness bar; get MindFriend live in its first market with confidence, not crossed fingers
  • Pass an independent security review with critical findings remediated before go-live
  • Prove the full booking-to-session flow end-to-end, including every failure path, across real devices and networks

In your first 6-12 months:

  • Turn a freelance-built platform into a maintainable, well-owned codebase with a team to match
  • Establish a sane delivery cadence and the engineering and product processes we'll scale on
  • Set the post-launch roadmap and start shipping against it

Who You Are

  • 8+ years building software, with senior or lead engineering experience and you've carried real product responsibility, not just executed someone else's spec
  • You've shipped a consumer product that takes real payments and handles sensitive personal data, to production and through real users
  • You've worked somewhere the security and data bar is real health-tech, fintech, or similar. You're not learning why it matters here
  • You can run a security review and stand up the controls behind it yourself, not just brief someone else to
  • Hands-on operator first, leader second: you lead through doing
  • You work directly and candidly with a non-technical founder

A bonus, not a requirement: you've been part of an early-stage or founding team before and know how to operate without much process; marketplace or telehealth experience; multi-jurisdiction products; or having taken a product through SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / GDPR.

Why this role matters

In a category built on trust, the technical decisions are the business. Whether a session holds, whether data stays safe, whether the platform feels solid that's what earns the trust everything else depends on. As a founding-team member you'll build the foundation MindFriend grows on, and shape the company from its first day live. This is a rare chance to own the technical heart of a company at the moment it matters most

Benefits

What we offer

A founding-team seat working directly to the founder, with real authority and real ownership of the problems that matter most. A product that's already built and a launch to drive, not a blank page. Competitive cash compensation plus equity, reflecting the seniority and ownership of the role. And a mission worth the work making trustworthy mental-health support easier to find.

How To Apply

Write to us one short story: a product you took to launch that handled payments or sensitive data what you were responsible for, and what nearly went wrong. We value substance over polish; tell us what you've built, not just where you've worked.

title: Senior Director, Product
descriptionHtml:
Who is Nexxen?

Flexible advertising, unified by data. Nexxen empowers advertisers, agencies, publishers and broadcasters around the world to utilize data and advanced TV in the ways that are most meaningful to them. Our flexible and unified technology stack comprises a demand-side platform (“DSP”) and supply-side platform (“SSP”), with the Nexxen Data Platform at its core.

Why join the Nexxen team?

title: Head of Engineering & Product
descriptionHtml:
Linkedin: www.linkedin.com/company/mindfriend/

Website: mindfriend.com/

MindFriend

  • Remote (UK/EU hours)
  • Full-time


We're looking for our senior engineering and product leader who will take MindFriend safely to launch and build the platform, and the team, that come after.

MindFriend is a mental-health marketplace connecting people with verified, licensed clinicians for online therapy: search, booking, payments, and live video, audio and chat sessions in one place. The platform is built and largely working, with a capable lead developer and a team. We're now bringing in the senior leader who will set the engineering bar, decide when we're ready to launch, and grow both the platform and the team from there with a level of ownership only the earliest team members ever get.

This role carries more weight than most engineering jobs. We handle sensitive health data and host live therapy sessions, so reliability and security aren't features they are the trust the entire category depends on. The person who gets this right will have real authority to do it properly, and will help shape what MindFriend becomes.

A word of honesty

This is a founding-team role at an early-stage company, which means it is hands-on. You will get into the code. You will run the QA passes yourself. You will test a video session on a bad connection at 9pm because a launch depends on it. You will make calls with incomplete information and live with them. You'll lead a small team and a freelance bench but you'll lead by doing, not just directing. If you want a purely strategic seat with people beneath you to execute, this is the wrong role. If you want to own the hardest, most consequential technical problems in the company and see them through, read on.

Requirements

What you'll be responsible for

  • The launch decision setting the readiness bar, and holding launch until it's met
  • Reliability of live video, audio and chat sessions on a user's old laptop and a clinician's poor wifi, not just a developer's machine
  • Security and privacy of sensitive health data the controls that keep us defensible, and an independent security review before we go live
  • End-to-end quality of the booking-and-payments flow, including the failure paths most teams skip
  • The product direction after launch what we build next, in what order, and why
  • Leading and growing the engineering and product team

What Success Looks Like

In your first weeks — to launch:

  • Own and close out the launch readiness bar; get MindFriend live in its first market with confidence, not crossed fingers
  • Pass an independent security review with critical findings remediated before go-live
  • Prove the full booking-to-session flow end-to-end, including every failure path, across real devices and networks

In your first 6-12 months:

  • Turn a freelance-built platform into a maintainable, well-owned codebase with a team to match
  • Establish a sane delivery cadence and the engineering and product processes we'll scale on
  • Set the post-launch roadmap and start shipping against it

Who You Are

  • 8+ years building software, with senior or lead engineering experience and you've carried real product responsibility, not just executed someone else's spec
  • You've shipped a consumer product that takes real payments and handles sensitive personal data, to production and through real users
  • You've worked somewhere the security and data bar is real health-tech, fintech, or similar. You're not learning why it matters here
  • You can run a security review and stand up the controls behind it yourself, not just brief someone else to
  • Hands-on operator first, leader second: you lead through doing
  • You work directly and candidly with a non-technical founder

A bonus, not a requirement: you've been part of an early-stage or founding team before and know how to operate without much process; marketplace or telehealth experience; multi-jurisdiction products; or having taken a product through SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / GDPR.

Why this role matters

In a category built on trust, the technical decisions are the business. Whether a session holds, whether data stays safe, whether the platform feels solid that's what earns the trust everything else depends on. As a founding-team member you'll build the foundation MindFriend grows on, and shape the company from its first day live. This is a rare chance to own the technical heart of a company at the moment it matters most

Benefits

What we offer

A founding-team seat working directly to the founder, with real authority and real ownership of the problems that matter most. A product that's already built and a launch to drive, not a blank page. Competitive cash compensation plus equity, reflecting the seniority and ownership of the role. And a mission worth the work making trustworthy mental-health support easier to find.

How To Apply

Write to us one short story: a product you took to launch that handled payments or sensitive data what you were responsible for, and what nearly went wrong. We value substance over polish; tell us what you've built, not just where you've worked.

title: Product Management - Digital Transformation - Vice President
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in the Product Management team to partner with the Business.

As a Vice President of Product Management in wholesale lending services team, you will lead the strategy and delivery of digital solutions that transform our wholesale lending business.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve product vision, multi-year strategy, and roadmap, aligning to business priorities, regulatory/controls requirements, and customer outcomes.
  • Lead people management: hire, coach, develop, and performance-manage product talent; set operating cadence, standards, and career growth plans.
  • Establish and run program governance (operating model, decision forums, intake/prioritization, dependency management, risk/issue management, and execution reporting).
  • Provide data insights for leadership: define KPI frameworks/OKRs, build executive-level dashboards, translate metrics into narrative, and drive decisions with evidence.
  • Direct solution discovery with cross-functional partners (engineering, design, data, operations, controls) to identify scalable solutions and validate value.
  • Lead product planning and delivery across portfolios/releases—ensuring scope clarity, sequencing, and timely launches with measurable benefits.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and controls to define target-state workflows, requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and customer value.
  • Apply Agile-at-scale practices to improve throughput and predictability; remove impediments and manage trade-offs across competing priorities.
  • Drive change management and end-user adoption: stakeholder mapping, comms/training plans, enablement materials, feedback loops, and adoption measurement.
  • Ensure quality and readiness through test management and automation, production verification, and post-release monitoring; drive continuous improvement via root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering to ensure secure, resilient delivery and alignment to architecture, data, and platform standards.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, IT, or related field
  • Demonstrated leadership as a VP/Senior Product Manager/Product Lead delivering digital transformation in financial services (wholesale lending).
  • Strong understanding of wholesale lending processes, digital technologies, and risk/controls considerations in regulated environments.
  • Proven people leadership experience (managing PM/PO teams), including coaching, operating cadence, and talent development.
  • Strong change management capability to drive adoption and measure behavior change/outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, organization, and presentation skills.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office and Agile tooling (e.g., Jira/Confluence or equivalent).

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Expertise across the product lifecycle: discovery → delivery → launch → adoption → optimization.
  • Strong data literacy: KPI/OKR design, dashboarding, insight generation, and executive storytelling to influence decisions.
  • Experience leading program governance and cross-functional execution across multiple workstreams and dependencies.

About Us

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Product Director
descriptionHtml:
Board-level leadership | Global impact | Safety-critical innovation


Hybrid (3 days onsite) | Wolverhampton, UK


The package is designed for senior leaders: £100,000–£110,000, Halma Director bonus scheme, car allowance, plus strong benefits


What if your product decisions could protect lives, shape industries, and define a company’s future?

At Fortress Safety, product leadership is not a function — it’s a strategic growth engine. We’re now appointing a Product Director to join our Board Team, reporting directly to the Managing Director, and to shape the long-term product strategy of a global, safety-critical business.


This role requires an experienced professional who has a background in manufacturing / engineered products, not software / IT / technology related products or services.


This is a rare opportunity to define what we build, how we compete, and where we invest — while leading teams whose work keeps people safe in hazardous environments worldwide.


Why this role matters

Since 1977, Fortress Safety has been protecting people and equipment through engineered machinery safety and interlocking solutions. As part of Halma plc, a FTSE 100 group of purpose-driven businesses, we operate with autonomy, accountability, and a clear focus on impact.

As Product Director, you will:

  • Set the multi‑year global product vision that underpins Fortress’ growth
  • Ensure our portfolio delivers customer‑led differentiation, not feature-led delivery
  • Balance long-term platform value creation with near-term commercial impact
  • Act as a strategic anchor at board level, shaping enterprise decisions

Your leadership will directly influence safety outcomes, commercial performance, and organisational capability.


What you’ll be doing

As a member of the Fortress Board, you will:

  • Set and govern the global product and portfolio strategy aligned to growth ambitions
  • Lead and develop Product Management, R&D, and Safety Services teams globally
  • Provide strategic oversight of Research & Development, from early concept through to production
  • Own accountability for the current and future product portfolio, ensuring alignment with customer needs, global safety standards, and regulatory requirements
  • Work in close partnership with the Innovation Director, Sales, Operations, and Halma peers
  • Translate market trends, regulation, and customer insight into clear strategic choices
  • Strengthen portfolio governance across core, adjacent, and future opportunities

You will lead through clarity, collaboration, and influence — not hierarchy.


Who this role is for

This role is designed for a board-level enterprise product leader operating in complex, regulated, engineered environments.


You’ll bring:

  • Degree-level education (or equivalent experience)
  • Proven success delivering results within complex technical product organisations
  • Experience launching products in highly regulated markets
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with board-level credibility
  • The ability to communicate complex technical topics simply and persuasively
  • A genuinely global mindset, comfortable working across cultures and geographies
  • Confidence to challenge the status quo — paired with curiosity and humility


And just as importantly, you’ll be:

  • Low ego, high impact
  • A developer of people and capability
  • Comfortable making decisions in ambiguity
  • Purpose-driven, with a bias for action, accountability, and teamwork


What’s in it for you

This is a role with real influence, autonomy, and long-term horizon.

  • Board-level appointment with genuine strategic mandate
  • Opportunity to shape a global product portfolio in safety-critical markets
  • Competitive salary: £100,000 – £110,000
  • Participation in the Halma Director Bonus Scheme
  • Company car or car allowance
  • 25 days holiday plus UK bank holidays
  • Competitive pension contributions
  • 14 weeks fully paid parental leave
  • Group healthcare (medical, dental & vision options)
  • Access to wellbeing and employee assistance programmes
  • Long-service recognition


Hybrid working with a visible, consistent presence at our Lanesfield site near Wolverhampton. International travel forms part of the role.


Inclusion & belonging

At Fortress Safety, we don’t just accept difference — we celebrate it. We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, we’re here to support you.


Ready to shape the future of safety?

If you’re motivated by purpose, impact, and enterprise-level leadership, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help chart the next chapter of Fortress Safety.

- Proven success delivering results within complex technical product organisations
- Experience launching products in highly regulated markets
- Strong commercial and financial acumen, with board-level credibility
- The ability to communicate complex technical topics simply and persuasively
- A genuinely global mindset, comfortable working across cultures and geographies
- Confidence to challenge the status quo — paired with curiosity and humility


And just as importantly, you’ll be:

- Low ego, high impact

This is a role with real influence, autonomy, and long-term horizon.

- Opportunity to shape a global product portfolio in safety-critical markets
- Competitive salary: £100,000 – £110,000
- Participation in the Halma Director Bonus Scheme
- Company car or car allowance
- 25 days holiday plus UK bank holidays
- Competitive pension contributions
- 14 weeks fully paid parental leave
- Group healthcare (medical, dental & vision options)
- Access to wellbeing and employee assistance programmes
- Long-service recognition


Hybrid working with a visible, consistent presence at our Lanesfield site near Wolverhampton. International travel forms part of the role.
