title: Sr. Director, Product Management Hardware
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG, we’re driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future.

Vivint Smart Home, an NRG owned company, is a leading smart home company in the United States, dedicated to redefining the home experience with intelligent products and services. We find purpose in proactively protecting and keeping our customers connected to home, no matter where they are. Join the Smart Home team to create smarter, safer and more sustainable homes.

Position Summary: Sr. Director Product Mgmt. - Hardware

In this key leadership role, you will serve as the Senior Director of Product Management, acting as the single-threaded technical product leader for Vivint’s core hardware and smart home ecosystem. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, serving as an independent strategic engine for the organization. You are responsible for defining the 3-year product hardware strategy and technical roadmap, expanding our physical suite from standalone components into a cohesive, highly intelligent ecosystem.

This role requires a unique intersection of physical hardware lifecycle mastery and cutting-edge software execution, specifically focused on deploying advanced machine learning and AI experiences to millions of users. You will lead a team of Technical Product Managers and work cross-functionally to ensure our devices work seamlessly on behalf of our customers—giving back time, keeping them safe, and saving them money.

Primary Responsibilities

Strategic Hardware & Ecosystem Leadership

  • Hardware Portfolio Strategy: Own the definition, multi-year sequencing, and execution of Vivint’s core device portfolio roadmap (including intelligent cameras, panels, sensors, and perimeter security devices).
  • Ecosystem Orchestration: Serve as the strategic thought leader on how disparate hardware endpoints, cloud platforms, and local connectivity protocols function together as a unified, frictionless, and personalized Vivint ecosystem.
  • White Space Incubation: Autonomously identify, evaluate, and secure investment for "white space" opportunities, disruptive hardware technologies, and emerging connectivity standards to expand the enterprise footprint.

AI Experiences & Technical Execution

  • AI Feature Roadmap: Define and drive the technical product vision for embedded and cloud-based AI experiences, transforming reactive hardware into proactive, predictive systems (e.g., leveraging computer vision, edge-AI processing, and machine learning models).
  • Technical Deep-Dives: Author high-quality, data-driven narrative documents (PRFAQs, 3-Year Operating Plans) to align senior executive leadership (VP+) on high-stakes product investments, technical trade-offs, and architectural dependencies.
  • Lifecycle & Performance Mechanisms: Establish and scale rigorous product planning and operational review mechanisms (such as hardware-software integration loops, lifecycle milestones, and usage telemetry tracking) to ensure data-driven iterations across the portfolio.

Leadership, Influence & Team Coaching

  • Team Management: Directly manage, mentor, and scale a lean team of high-performing Technical Product Managers, fostering a deep culture of product ownership, analytical rigor, and extreme customer-centricity.
  • Independent Matrixed Leadership: Operate independently to influence, unblock, and align a highly matrixed, multi-disciplinary organization spanning Product, Software/Hardware Engineering, Industrial Design, Supply Chain, and AI Data Science teams.
  • Execution Excellence: Translate complex, high-level corporate visions into precise, unambiguous technical requirements, maintaining a relentless path from initial prototype optimization to high-volume global manufacturing.
  • Post-Launch Analytics: Own the post launch product and data deep dives, ensuring once launched our products are best in class and maintain operability across all devices. While also ensuring that you are building in the right metrics and measurements to self-heal and monitor our hardware once in the market.

Required Skills & Functional Dimensions

  • Autonomous Strategic Mindset: Proven ability to define long-term product frameworks and navigate intense ambiguity independently. You must be comfortable making high-impact decisions and establishing a product path without complete data.
  • Hardware-Software Lifecycle Mastery: Deep, end-to-end familiarity with consumer electronics product development, including industrial design constraints, firmware, embedded systems, global supply chain dependencies, and post-launch ecosystem scaling.
  • AI & ML Literacy: Solid technical understanding of how to apply machine learning approaches to consumer-facing hardware architectures (e.g., object detection, predictive automation, and cloud-to-edge processing architectures).
  • Stakeholder Influence & Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Proven track record of presenting complex technical strategies.

Required Education & Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of product management experience, with at least 5+ years dedicated specifically to shipping complex consumer electronics, IoT devices, or highly integrated smart home ecosystems.
  • Technical Background: Demonstrated experience managing products that require close coordination with software engineers, hardware architects, and data/AI scientists. Direct experience with smart home standards (e.g., Matter, Zigbee, Thread) is a significant plus.
  • Leadership Track Record: 3+ years of experience directly managing and developing technical product professionals, with a proven ability to scale team capabilities.
  • Education: B.S. or M.S. in a Technical Field (Computer Science, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or related discipline); MBA or equivalent business experience preferred.

The base salary range for this position is: $209,600 - $345,840* *The base salary range above represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include annual bonus, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards. In addition the position may be eligible to participate in the benefits program which include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending accounts.

NRG Energy is committed to a drug and alcohol-free workplace. To the extent permitted by law and any applicable collective bargaining agreement, employees are subject to periodic random drug testing, and post-accident and reasonable suspicion drug and alcohol testing. EOE AA M/F/Protected Veteran Status/Disability. Level, Title and/or Salary may be adjusted based on the applicant's experience or skills.

EEO is the Law Poster (The poster can be found at http://www.eeoc.gov/employers/upload/poster_screen_reader_optimized.pdf)

title: Director, Product Operations (Remote)
descriptionHtml:
For our client, we are seeking a Director Product Operations (remote) to join the team of a leader in the Healthcare space. This role will lead continuous improvement work focused on process discipline, productivity, and measurable operating gains. You will collaborate with field leadership, support functions, and cross-functional stakeholders to improve accountability, service delivery, and operational consistency. The position offers the opportunity to influence operational scale, customer outcomes, and organizational performance within a healthcare environment.

Location: Remote - US based candidates only, no visa sponsorship available

Compensation: $120,000 – $150,000 annually

Responsibilities

  • Developing and leading the Product Operations function to support product strategy and execution
  • Establishing scalable processes and frameworks across various departments
  • Driving product portfolio planning and prioritization frameworks
  • Building reporting systems to track product performance and operational KPIs
  • Facilitating cross-functional communication to ensure execution consistency

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field; MBA preferred
  • 8+ years of experience in Product Operations, Product Management, or related functions
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience managing high-performing teams
  • Strong understanding of product development methodologies including Agile, Scrum, and Lean
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with experience using data visualization tools

Benefits

  • Many opportunities for engagement with culture teams and fellow associates
  • Support for continuous learning with access to industry experts
  • Casual dress code allowing for jeans
  • Unlimited PTO for salaried associates and generous holiday benefits
  • Education reimbursement and wellness program reimbursements

Our client is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification—your background could be exactly what this team needs.
